It is so cozy for a hardwood floor as it keeps my feet warm when I wake up in the morning instead of touching a cold floor. The colors of the rug is true to sight, BLACK! Like blackity black. I have vacuum over it once and did not find any shedding, so I was grateful for that. It's a great bedroom rug and I may purchase one for the living room.

reviews.title: Such a bargain. Light weight n fluffy
reviews.review_text: So nice. Light weight n fluffy i use my leaf blower puff it. Its not the heavy rug u see for sale for rooms this is light weight n i love it sorry for the bad pict we just moved in n needed something in the living room as it is hardwood floors and we needed something inexpensive and easy to move

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.review_text: I loved this carpet. My dog loves it too! She usually goes to the bathroom on the carpet during to anxiety when we are gone. She loves the carpet so much she hasn't has anxiety she just rolls on it and sleeps. The only thing that was wrong is , its very hard to vacuum

No too thick just enough cushion under my feet and is so soft to touch, I did accidentally spill water the first day I got it but I was able to blot it dry very quickly, and it wasn't soaked. My son who has sensory issues loves how cozy it feels, and there is no shedding.

reviews.title: Nefoso Shag Area Rug 8' x 10' Soft Fluffy Area Rug
reviews.review_text: I had small (really small) area rugs in the living room. It is also a cold room. The 8'x10' rug covered a large bare area in the room, and the small, small area rugs were placed on top of the newcomer. The gray color complimented the area rugs and the furniture. Easy to unwrap and lay down, about 5 minutes.

reviews.title: Not a quality rug. Headache from toxic smell.
reviews.review_text: I knew when the package arrived and the rug was shrink wrapped I shouldn't even bother opening it but I did because of so many positive reviews. You can't even call this a rug. It's is a piece of useless, smelly piece of garbage. Will be returning this thing. It's horrible.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.review_text: They advertise it as shag rug,but it actually a fauxe fir rug. It's very,very thin and super slippery. My teenage grand child has fallen twice on it. I do not recommend this product to anyone unless you want a fauxe fir product. Shedds when vacuumed also. This is a poor quality area rug.

reviews.title: Still Undecided??
reviews.review_text: The size and color of the rug is great. The prize is amazing. The rug is very soft. But the texture of the rug is hard to explain. Its very slippery. It reminds me of a bath matt. My cats love it! But Im still undecided. It doesn't feel like a real rug .... I guess for the price I'll keep it.

reviews.title: highly recommend! great for any room!
reviews.review_text: I ordered 2 of the 8 x 10 rugs; a black one for my sons room, and a pink one for my toddlers room. they are so soft and comfy and really pull the rooms together! I did wait for them to go on sale so I did get them for around $50 a piece so that was a great deal to me!

reviews.title: Not good for toddlers
reviews.review_text: I bought this because my grandson just started walking, and i thought it would give some extra padding to the hard wood floor. I waited 72 hours, as suggested, for it to "plump up" and i still never felt one bit of memory foam in this rug. it made the floor much more slippery, and easier for him to trip. Very bad idea for babies learning to walk . Very thin, and slippery.

I ordered this to lay down on my cement basement floor. I didn't want to spend a lot of money but still wanted a rug comfortable to walk on. This rug is great! It's thin but not too thin. Its soft and feels nice on bare feet. I liked it so well I bought another! Great value!

reviews.title: Great deal!
reviews.review_text: I ordered 2 sizes of this rug, 8 x 10 %26 5 x8. I was surprised and concerned that they were sent in a very small box. I decided to open the smaller rug first and would just return both if I didn't like it. It came in a vacuum sealed bag that instantly expands upon opening. The instructions said to lay it flat for 3 days. I did and it was fine and very soft. I was nervous it would shed but it didn't. The backing was soft rubber like a bath mat so I had concerns that it would pull up when being vacuumed. Nope. Both rugs were for our odd shaped bedroom with the larger going under our bed. I had intended to lay it vertically with the long side going from top of the bed to the bottom. Once we felt how nice and soft the fur was, we decided to lay it the short way to allow a larger amount to step on getting out of the bed. Truly impressed and believe me I tried to find fault.

reviews.title: 4 stars!
reviews.review_text: Love the rug. Great price, less than $40 for a very large rug. Be aware it takes a day or two to completely flatten. The kids never want to relax on the couch anymore. It's so soft and comfortable. It doesn't vacuum easily. The high pile gets wrapped around the vacuum brushes. I don't mind this because I can detach the head. Love the rug!

The rug comes in folded. Instruction sheet said it takes 3 days (72 hours) to get flat. But rug is wavy on the edge and the folding mark appeared bulgy and misformed due to the extracted air press for easy transportation. Not a great shaped rug! I am disappointed.

reviews.title: Soft, Plush and Gorgeous
reviews.review_text: The carpet is very soft, the color is perfect, true to size and easy to lay, you just have to let it settle for a couple of days and have patience, it will flatten out. The bottom has a rubbery texture which gives it a good fit and keeps it in place.

reviews.title: Soft but not a rug
reviews.review_text: I wanted a plain black rug to put under my bed and spread out into the length of my bedroom. This is not a rug as you think of a rug. It's very soft but, it's more like a big throw that you would put on your couch or bed. There's no padding or structure to the "rug" just a very soft fabric to try to control. I say that because the fabric doesn't want to spread smoothly. It's not a rug, it's a very soft spread. I wanted to return it but it was more trouble to get it out from under my bedframe and than into a vacum bag and fitting into a box. No, I kept it and I'm careful not to trip over the big ripples and waves in the fabric.

reviews.title: Great Rug for the Price!
reviews.review_text: Great shag rug for the price! Bought the 8x10 and the 9x12 to cover up some old carpet and it looks cute, very soft, the pets love it too. It's pretty thin, but the padding would be comfortable on a hard floor also. We'll see how well it holds up in a high traffic area, but i think it would be absolutely perfect in a bedroom.

reviews.title: Great ride for the great price
reviews.review_text: I seriously did not expect much due to the price of this rug. I bought it for my great room and my dogs. It is so cute and they absolutely love it. I would've paid $50 for this rug. It is thin, but the shag of the carpet makes it look worth more than it actually is.

reviews.title: Don't waste your money
reviews.review_text: Does not sit well. Slides all over the place when you walk on it. Padding is thin so it feels like you're still walking on a hard floor. This thing keeps wrinkling and folding up every time it's stepped on. Read the reviews here so I decided to purchase based on reviews. They're lying. If you want the truth, this is it right here. It's not worth the money.

reviews.title: A Shot in the Dark Proved to be Disappointing
reviews.review_text: The rug came with a long dirty 3-foot line below the rug fibers. The fibers themselves stuck wildly to my husband's pants when he kneeled on the rug to feel how thin was the padding beneath the top fur layer. The fibers came up in clumps of fur and tangled fibers! I was utterly disappointed. We cannot use or keep this rug. Our previous rug cost far less and offered unbeatable quality, bounce and durability. That is what I thought I was getting. Alas, it's not even 24 hours since it arrived. It's got a roundtrip ticket to WalMartville. Bye bye baby. Sorry you weren't what I was expecting. But the pink fur was pretty to look at. That's all.
This rug is awesome.. So soft and had zero issues getting it to lay flat once out of the package. Highly recommend

reviews.title: Priceless
reviews.review_text: Very nice addition to my living room and is very comfortable to walk on barefoot. The grandkids like to sit on the floor now.
with time the material gets ugly, the hairs of it become more tangled and looks ugly, . . does the job, it was beautiful when it arrived
Great rug, fluffy, but a bit slippery feel to it. I'm an elder so for safety reasons it's not for me.

reviews.title: Wrong Size
reviews.review_text: Nice Carpet. But sent me a 7x9 instead of a 8x10 like I ordered. I have it all laying out now. I'm not returning it now.

reviews.title: Shag carpet in
reviews.review_text: Love the texture and cool feeling of this carpet, it goes well with my bedroom and the dogs love it too

reviews.title: Quality Rug
reviews.review_text: The quality of the rug was nice. The color was the perfect the size was perfect for me it definitely was a great price
Looks just like picture. Strange synthetic material. Had bad smell. Had to put rug outside in sun with deodorizer to air out

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.review_text: It's a CHEAP rug. But it's also a throw away , it shows wear immediately and gets “tangled”. Vacuum doesn't help.

reviews.title: Great buy!
reviews.review_text: very soft and fluffy with a plush, cushion like step when walking on it. Color is spot on and matched in the room perfectly. I love it

reviews.title: You will enjoy!
reviews.review_text: plush and comfortable. high quality fabric. The texture of this rugs feels great on my feet. very durable and easy to clean so far.
It's a very cool looking rug and feels great to walk on. It is very large. It shed. But only for a couple days and it's fine now.

reviews.title: value for your buck!
reviews.review_text: The product is very plush and feels quite nice walking on it.Thickness is really good.. Great value for your buck.

reviews.title: Makes my room look much cuter
reviews.review_text: i got this carpet on sale and i'm very satisfied with the quality, within 24 hours it got super soft, and it's very comfortable to walk on and lay on

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.review_text: I bought two of these in the cream, it definitely has a color, not just off white, so they are perfect for my home!
I bought 2 and Ive had the rugs opn for a week and their still bunched up. Should be fully opn after 72 hours. I wouldn't recommend

reviews.title: Best item I've bought all year
reviews.review_text: oh I can't because it the size it said it would be and it's very very soft to not stiff like a regular room size rug/carpet
Waited 3 weeks and never even received the product. Finally got a refund from Walmart after the third week..

reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.review_text: It's decent, but very slippery (if you're walking in socks you slide all around) and it sheds like mad! We have huge balls of shag tumbling throughout our house like tumbleweed from this rug.

reviews.title: Comfy, fluffy carpet.
reviews.review_text: Carpet is very soft and comfy. Everyone loves to lay on it . It is very fluffy! Young nephew loves to slide across it in his socks! Would highly recommend it! Might be buying another one for our bedroom.
i liked the softness of the rug but i dont see it lasting very long. its very thin and easily moves and the corners fold too easily. This definitely wont be used as a long term rug.

reviews.title: Recommend 100%
reviews.review_text: Wow the size is great at this price! Full 8by 10 ft. Huge! So soft and cushioned. We all want to sleep on the floor. I would definitely purchase again.

reviews.title: Don't buy this rug.
reviews.review_text: This rug was attractive, but it's super slippery. I was so afraid that I was going to slip and fall, that I returned it. I would not recommend purchasing it.
Well made. Beautiful color. Works perfect with an anti slip pad. The color works with a wide variety of colors. I have it in my bedroom. You also can't beat the price.

This does not even feel like a actual rule and look like a throat. They put a cover on the back. This is not what I expected and yes, I am going to return this. This will not lay on the floor and stay.

reviews.title: Much more beautiful than expected
reviews.review_text: I will be purchasing more. this carpet/rug is much more beautiful and full of comfort than I truly expected. My bones are very sensitive and fragile, walking and sitting on top of the rug brings so much comfort. the color is amazing.

reviews.title: Better than expected!
reviews.review_text: The padding under the carpet is cushy and way better than I anticipated! The “fluffy” texture is loved by our toddler. Not sure how it will hold up with minimal foot traffic (bedroom rug) and how much dog hair will stick.
so soft and vacuums up very nicely! has nice padding. love that it come folded and vacuumed sealed and not rolled up where you have to wait for the corners to lay!
I purchased the same rug, but a different color in this rug is not the same texture or feel. It's very hard to walk across. I'm just not happy at all.
Very lumpy. You can't vacuum or wash it. I will NEVER get another one. The color was supposed to be white but I received a beige. It also gets flat too fast. Not good quality. Also, very thin.
Although this rug is pretty to look at, it has a very slick surface that is a hazard to walk on. If I had known before I bought it, I certainly wouldn't have.

reviews.title: Very DISAPPOINTED
reviews.review_text: The rug is beautiful to look at and the texture was great. However the top separated from the foam cushion within two days. AND IT SHED ALL OVER THE ROOM !!! So unfortunately I had to return it.
The problem is not the rug the problem is I ordered 2 rugs of the same...they sent me two different rugs

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.review_text: I love this rug, and so do my dogs. Feels good on bare feet and it's not too fluffy, good thickness on the padding. Doesn't slide.
It' just didn't open right , and it was full of humps and very wrinkle. And no Refund yet to be seen over 8 weeks.

reviews.title: best carpet ever
reviews.review_text: the softest carpet I've ever felt in my life.. this carpet is better than I even expected it to be. I would buy it a thousand times over!!!
Thus rug is very soft to the touch, and the pad is suprisingly cushiony. Theonly complaint I have is the color was too yellow .
I'm returning it although nice product it has a very yellow overtone in the color. Need something more beige
my package arrived on time and was left right where i asked, the product is amazing and i love it! it makes my living room so much more comfortable

These carpets are so soft and nice. We love them…I ordered nine of these in various sizes. Our Great Pyrenees absolutely loves them, she rolls around on them all the time. Would recommend. Our robot vacuums them with no problems.

reviews.title: Colour does not match at all
reviews.review_text: Be careful ! The colour shown in the photo does not at all match the original rug colour! The colour in reality is a shocking pink, darker and more like cotton candy's colour. I had a surprise when opened the package. Need to return it.
This rug is so soft. It is ideal for child's room. They would be so comfy to play on it. It looks beautiful in my room. I got the dark gray one and it goes perfectly with my headboard
This rug seems well made, and it is soft, fluffy and pleasant to walk on. my cat quite enjoys it, and i occasionally lie down on the rug with him. all the stars, and i would recommend!

reviews.title: like sitting on a cloud
reviews.review_text: This is so soft and fluffy. I am using over my cement basement floor and i feel like i am walking on a cloud. i have only had it a day but it looks like its great quality.
this rug looks exactly like the picture it's like a buttery brown and so soft it's vacuum sealed and folded very well packed I like it would recommend thank you Rita

reviews.title: Price👍, Size👍, Texture👍, Color😔
reviews.review_text: I love everything about this rug; price, size and texture, the only problem is the color is more yellow than the cream color I expected. It does however look less yellow once it has expanded out of the packaging.

reviews.title: Soft %26 Fluffy
reviews.review_text: Really impressed with the quality of this item for the price. It is nice and fluffy. Stays put, doesn't slide around. The color was more of a cream than a yellow which was perfect. Would like to grab another for my bedroom.

reviews.title: Gave us the wrong color
reviews.review_text: Good quality but they did not give us the right color, we previously purchased a light gray rug from the same seller and this one is a much darkwr shade of gray

reviews.title: Not properly cut and won't lay flat
reviews.review_text: Save your money. The rug was not cut properly and had waves and bunch areas. I allowed it to sit for hours to see if it would flatten out but it wouldn't. Not worth the hassle to save some money on a rug.
so soft, the pad underneath so comfortable, love the packaging as well, the first time i didn't have to worry about corners coming up or rolling under.

reviews.title: Walking on a fluffy cloud
reviews.review_text: Loved it didn't disappoint so nice and the perfect size chose to put it in living room. Great buy for the value. Would order again. Super soft and big my family loves it.
This rug is soft and cozy. I have about 3 weeks with is and not hasn't shed, seems like good quality it will last. Using it in my bedroom, great choice.

reviews.title: Yes and no
reviews.review_text: I would recommend if you don't have dogs (pets) the look and felt good but it held everything like dog bones or any small object the brought in or played with hard to vacuum
The dark grey rug would not lay down flat because of the way it was shipped folded tightly in plastic. I tried to steam the back and laid it out for over 48 hours and nothing worked. Took it back.
I liked the quality of the rug, it was fluffy and soft. I didn't like the color. I ordered the color, light brown but it had to much yellow in it.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.review_text: Honestly really love this rug… the padding gives it a nice extra squish, the color is great, the shag is nice quality, our dogs and toddler love it. All around a great snag for the sale price and would buy again!

reviews.title: Great for the price
reviews.review_text: Love the rug ESPECIALLY for the price. I couldn't see myself paying $200 for a large area rug so took a shot on this one. Super soft and cushioned. Sheds slightly but overall worth the price.
SUPER SOFT!! easily puffed into size nearly immediately. took forever to place furniture because I couldn't stop laying on it.definetly recommend for play area
i love this rug but if you have animals im not sure it will hold up to that. Definitely for just appearance purposes only its starts to matt a little after a while but its so soft
This is a very nice rug. Very soft. The memory foam is nice and squishy lol. Not sure how well it would hold up in a high traffic area but so far I am very pleased.

OMG its so so soft. I can wash it in a big machine at the laundry mat. Its very flexible. my cats love to slide on it. I only got it to protect my hardwood floors from getting scratches but wow Im glad I picked this.

reviews.title: SLIPPERY
reviews.review_text: The rug looks great and is truly very soft BUT it is very slippery. Walk on it with shoes or barefoot and you slip and slide. From a safety perspective, I cannot recommend it. It is not worth an injury or broken bone.
It is so comfortable and fluffy. It look and feel like high quality material. It doesn't shed and that's what I was worried about. I would definitely recommend this product to family and friends.

reviews.title: Economical and beautiful
reviews.review_text: We ordered two rugs. One was perfect. The second one the color didn't work, but we reordered and we cried the replacement promptly. Return of the second one was easy. Live this product
it was shipped vaccum paced, opened easily and is soft and comfortable to the touch ,only took a xouple of hours to flatten out and look great in our living room!!! very good pad too!!!

reviews.title: Amazing Soft Rug!
reviews.review_text: Exactly as described and very soft… very satisfied with this product being that I chose to do this route instead of paying workers to install carpet in my small room. I'd recommend this rug.
it's hard to clean I really didn't know that It couldn't be wet clean Now I'm so deeply disappointed that I brought it. Truly a total waste of money. I'm throwing it out.

reviews.title: Carpet
reviews.review_text: I love this rug... It's the right color. It's soft and fluffy. Nice sizes. Only thing was wrong with the rug is the smell. But I sprayed it and helped.

reviews.title: Good if you don't have messy toddlers
reviews.review_text: I love this carpet so fluffy and the foam makes it more comfortable the only downside it cannot handle vacuuming at all and with my toddler the crumbs that fall in it is a pain to get it out if u can even get to it

reviews.title: Soft rug
reviews.review_text: I like this type rug, once its out and settles in it is really soft. WHAT I Don't like is the way it's shrink wrapped, it holds the smell of the material in and take a few days of a good cross breeze to get it out.

reviews.title: a steal
reviews.review_text: I wish it was wrapped up like a normal rug, but honestly for 50 bucks this thing is a steal. it is so worth getting, for the size and how soft it is. I love it. hate that it has to settle to get the creases out. but would def recommend this item.

reviews.title: Love this rug!
reviews.review_text: I got the rug on sale for an area for my son to play on, the memory foam between the layers really helped. We had to get another mat to go on top but the rug really helped and I really like it for the half off price I got it for!

reviews.title: Happy….
reviews.review_text: Needs a big room, feels so good ! Not formal, but everyone who sees it really likes it. It's gray, but has a slight blue tint. Shouldn't be used in a room where tiny things can be dropped in the shag though. I'm happy with it….

reviews.title: Great price great product
reviews.review_text: Great price for a great product. Very lightweight. Should be easy to toss in the wash. The picture online makes the rug look like a cream color but it is a light yellow.
this rug is sooooo soft and comfy, looking at it online made me hesitant on buying it at first and I just took a chance and WOW it's absolutely amazing. The price is definitely not bad either .

the fluff was nice however the backing and top of rug weren't cut evenly. big lump in middle of rug. wouldn't recommend. I was hoping it would lay flat because I did like the fluff. the color was supposed to be light gray. looked more light blue.

reviews.title: Silky soft %26 plush!
reviews.review_text: Shipped very compact in airtight packaging. Once opened it came out easy to arrange in the room. Rug is a beautiful color and silky soft. I love walking barefoot on it. Great for any room! Going to order another for the living room.
Very pretty rug. It does shed some, but is comfortable to walk on. I was disappointed that it is such a very bright pink. I didn't expect that so it clashes with the other pinks in my bedroom.
This is a soft, fuzzy little bedroom rug. My fault…I didn't pay close enough attention to description. It just wasn't what I wanted and expected but great for another purpose.

reviews.title: Hard to maintain. Cheap quality.
reviews.review_text: This rug is very hard to maintain. It collects a ton of crumbs that can't vacuum out easily, as it has burned up two vacuums. The top part separates from the padding underneath. The vacuum just wants to eat it because of that.

reviews.title: Recommended for everyone!
reviews.review_text: This rug is soft and comes in great colors. I ordered it in pink and absolutely love its bright, a really great value, and makes my the space come together with the decor so well.

reviews.title: Amazing Shag Rug
reviews.review_text: This shag rug is the perfect rug for any bedroom. It feels amazing to step out on and keeps the floor warm. I've got so many compliments on it and did let people and family know where I bought. Once again thank you Walmart.
I like the rug but color wasn't right it was suppose to be caramel but was more orange, plus shag rug is not good for living room will get dirty fast over all I liked the rug
This is not like your typical carpet. I like it for what I'm using it for in my studio house. Not recommended for a high traffic area. Could be a thicker.

reviews.title: I love this rug!
reviews.review_text: I love am so happy with the rug! It's so pretty and looks great with my sofa. It has a cushion to it when you walk in it. Super easy to vacuum. My pup got to the living room and peed on my rug. To my suprise it did not soak in to the rug. I cleaned it right up! It's big and comfy. Fills up my space perfectly.

reviews.title: Great product, especially for the price!
reviews.review_text: I was pleasantly surprised as to how nice and soft and cushy this carpet is because of the price. It was well worth it and I bought another one because of it. The biggest thing that I liked about it as well is that it's light To move around the floor easily.

reviews.title: Don't eat the yellow snow
reviews.review_text: I love this rug. I have it in grey and it's so soft and comfortable and holds up well. I have to say I don't really like the colors in any of these. The gray is a blue gray, which you don't really realize until it shows up at your house. I just ordered the light yellow, and it looked like a cream color in the pictures but then when it arrived, and I put it next to my cream furniture is this gross yellow color like snow that's been peed on by all the neighborhood dogs. This rug is so comfortable. I just wish they made it in better more neutral colors.

reviews.title: Pretty hard to maintain
reviews.review_text: The rug starts out nice it's soft and has a cushy feel to it. However, it is very hard to clean and maintain. You can't vacuum it because it gets sucked up in the vacuum. It's hard to sweep it out because it's so deep so if you just wanna use it and then throw it away, it might be something to be used for, but I've tried to care for mine and now I regret having to clean house cause it's so hard to maintain this rug.

reviews.title: Won't lay flat weeks after purchasing
reviews.review_text: It's tough to put a do not recommend on this item. Had previously purchased 2 area rugs (different color and sizes of this same brand and style) so I was very hopeful when this one arrived. After multiple weeks, it still will not lay flat, ripples in the areas that it was folded. I don't know if it was folded too tightly and for too long that it stretched permanently this way. I have placed heavy totes on the area that won't settle and it's helped slightly. My previous purchases were perfect right out of the packaging. This is a very disappointing $80 spent.

reviews.title: Cheap But Unusable
reviews.review_text: This rug will not lay flat due to the sides not being the same size. Its a tripping hazzard as the rug gaps from the floor in some spots close to 6 inches with no way to make it lay flat. the rug is very soft but also think with little too no padding work some spots having more padding than others. I dioxide for the price i could make it work if there were issues but the rug is unusable due to the design flaw causing the extreme gapping. In addition, since this is sold by a third party, I'm having a hard time returning the item.

reviews.title: Snug Rug
reviews.review_text: It's safe to say I'd buy again This is my second time buying this rug I purchased the pink one and the grey one they are large which is what i was looking for and soft They make good bedroom rugs The grey one had a weird smell at first to me but it quickly faded away once out the plastic The pink one was thicker to me than the grey one It lays flat and only thing is the shaggy carpet hairs can take more work to clean so dont drop anything on them My kids love rolling around on them

reviews.title: Works in Toddler Playroom but would not buy again
reviews.review_text: My son was here when opend and we both just laughed. Although I bought for Family Room he immediately said, "Want me to put in the playroom?" This is about the quality of a very, very thin bath mat. It is not far from me calling it a blanket. I will say the "Plush" fabric is soft and I like it in my toddler age grandson's playroom but be aware, very very very little padding. I added foam padding underneath. I would not buy again.

reviews.title: Doesn't stay in place on tile floor
reviews.review_text: This rug is very soft, so we love that. It will not stay in place though. We used rug tape and rug stick'em triangles, none of which worked to keep it from being moved around the floor from people or animals. The bottom just tore, so now we have holes in the liner, very disappointing.

The worst thing thevrug caused allergic reaction to me and my pets. I was getting hives and my cats and dog were scratching like mad. it was a nice-looking shag rug, but you couldn't vacuum it as the shag knotted around crumbs and debris fallen onto carpet.

reviews.title: Very soft and fluffy
reviews.review_text: This rug is so so soft. Sadly it's hard to keep as fluffy over time, especially if you spill something and need to clean it. It took a long time to flatten out and still likes to bunch up at a fold line . I wasn't expecting amazing but am pleased with the quality vs. price and size .Color very close to advertised picture.

while this rug is indeed extremely soft and shaggy, it is very poor quality when it comes to shape and settlement. We've had this rug since September 2024 now and it has yet to fall flat. Still, there are bumps showing throughout the rug, which i can only describe as "rolled up towels" placed under the rug. when trodden on they settle but only to pop up elsewhere. We kept the rug because primarily, it's an underbed rug. I would not recommend this rug if you plan on using it in the center of the room.

It's a very nice rug for the price we paid. We got it when it was on sale for close to $50 and definitely worth it. It's very soft and has a little bit of cushion to it as well that makes it quite nice to walk on. Came packed up very small so needed to be rolled out and allowed to sit for about a day. Overall a very nice rug

reviews.title: Beautiful living room rug
reviews.review_text: I'm very satisfied overall with this purchase. It's exactly as expected; beautiful, soft and fluffy, yet durable and able to withstand the foot traffic of the living room. I purchased a light grey so it will fit any changes of decor. reviews.title: You'll wake, Guaranteed
reviews.review_text: After reading the reviews on this alarm clock i got all excited because i am most definitely a heavy sleeper and have a hard time getting up. The Buzz on the alarm is able to be set at different tones and you can set it to which you find most annoying. It has 4 options when setting the alarm to go off: Buzz, Buzz/Vibrate, Vibrate, and Off. The Vibrate feature itself will wake you up. When i first set up the clock it was sitting in the floor across the room and just the violent buzzing from the vibrate feature woke me up. This morning i woke up to just the Vibrate going off when i stuck it under my mattress. I really just wanted to test this out because of the people that referred me to it... reviews.title: It's okay
reviews.review_text: I have two areas of concern with this alarm clock. First, it is not as loud as I was expecting or desiring it to be. The whole reason we are buying it is to wake our daughter who sleeps through just about anything. This alarm not being nearly loud as implied, barely wakes her after several minutes and with the vibrator under her pillow. So I'd say it is okay and barely satisfactory, but was hoping for a little more "boom." My second concern is the connectors for the power and vibrator are not crisp. They loosely plug in to the back of the clock and I am worried over time they will begin to fall out easily but only time will tell. I would have much preferred a snug fit for these connectors. If I could give it a 3.5 and a maybe recommend, I probably would, but I like to err on the positive side, so I gave it a 4 and recommend.

reviews.title: Awesome volume, but shaker could be more effective
reviews.review_text: As someone who has sleep apnoea, and is a very deep sleeper in general, this is a Godsend. This is the first alarm clock I've ever found that I cannot sleep through, no matter what. While I'm disappointed with the bed-shaker to some degree, I'm overall very satisfied. At first, I was very impressed when the bedshaker, upon testing on a tabletop, was doing multiple flips, and seemed very strong. However, when it came to practical application (slid under the mattress, or under my pillow) it was less effective. When I think of a bedshaker, I think of something that actually moves the bed. I've been known to sleep through earthquakes and thunderstorms that threaten to break the windows. A small vibration just isn't enough to make a dent for me. By itself, it would never do what is needed, but in combination with the beep, it is fairly effective as a boost. Being aware that I've been known to smack an alarm clock off while still asleep, I was very glad to see the long cord, both for the main power plug, and for the bedshaker. I was able to place it far enough from my bed that I actually have to get up in order to turn it off, thus reducing the chance I'll fall back asleep after it shuts off. The duration of the beeps is also a plus in this regard. Overall, I would recommend this product to anyone who has ever had difficulty waking in the morning.

reviews.title: A must for sound sleepers!
reviews.review_text: Bought this for my 18 year old son who is a VERY sound sleeper and it works! It wakes him and the vibrating feature is fantastic! His friend told him about this alarm clock before I got it for him and his friend likes his too! All in all, a great product that I would recommend to anyone that has a hard time waking to regular alarm clocks. And a great value at Walmart.

reviews.title: That little extra "nudge"!
reviews.review_text: My son was struggling to get up for his college classes. He didn't want to irritate his roommate with the loud alarm, so he just uses the vibrating disc in his pillow and it does the trick! This clock is perfect for the heavy sleeper who can't get up.

This does wake you up and get you out of bed, i sometimes sleep through alarms but i don't think that's possible with this one, i do use the snooze button as i can't seem to just jump out of bed, i'm not a morning person!! I have not used the super shaker yet, but i will try that soon to see how that works!! I would say if you need a loud alarm to wake you up, then this is definately it!!

reviews.title: Very effective
reviews.review_text: Very loud. Plus it comes with a vibrating disc. My husband had the bright idea to put the vibrating disc between 2 metal bowls on the dresser. Daggum near gave me a heart attack. My idea was to put the disc on the headboard bed post so it would vibrate off and knock him in he head to wake him up in the morning. He was less than receptive to that idea. But the alarm is very loud and we ended up putting the disc between our very thick memory foam mattress and we can both still feel it. It definitely wakes us up in the morning. Best alarm we've ever bought.

reviews.title: Workswell
reviews.review_text: This clock woke up my son who can usually sleep through any alarm. The vibration he said really was strong and he placed it under his pillow for the best result. He wished it had a radio but I don't care about a radio as long as I don't have to shake to wake him myself. Good product!

reviews.title: Great for people with hearing loss
reviews.review_text: If you or someone else are hard of hearing, this clock is for you. Most alarm clocks are a high pitch sound that people with hearing losses cannot hear. This clock is the answer. If a person is deaf, it comes with a vibrating pad that can go under the pillow. Love this clock!

reviews.title: Best clock ever
reviews.review_text: I have been having problems with not hearing my alarms or simply sleeping straight through them and having to rush like crazy to get to work on time. My daughter recommended this clock (she has one too). The setup is super simple and the vibration box works wonderfully. I sleep better knowing that I am not going to oversleep --- best purchase I ever made!

reviews.title: Great alarm
reviews.review_text: This thing gets me out of bed before I can even think straight. It's very loud and the vibrating option works fantastic. The lights don't really do much, but a good touch if you need visuals to wake you up. Having the ability to set 2 different alarms is nice also.

reviews.title: No one will sleep through this alarm!
reviews.review_text: Lots of room for personal adjustments, i.e. pitch and volume. Intuitive set up. The only minor criticism is that if you go past the setup time for time or alarm you've got to go all the way around 24 hours to set the desired time instead of having a reverse button to go back a few minutes. It is not so bad since the clock has a fast and slow forward adjust mode. If you need a LOUD alarm clock this is the baby.

reviews.title: Sonic Bomb is a great name for this
reviews.review_text: I am a cochlear implant wearer and when I am not wearing them I cannot hear alarms. This has lights that flash, a bed shaker and it buzzes. I definately needed this and I am so glad I purchased this one. I use to rely on my dogs waking me up when they hear the alarm, now I can get up on my own because of the bed shaker and I wake up the dogs now.....(sweet revenge). If you are hard of hearing or deaf, this is a must have.

reviews.title: Better than a cell phne
reviews.review_text: This is the best alarm clock that I have ever had, but a little bit more than I wanted to spend. Not only does it have an ultra loud buzzer, but it also shakes the bed like crazy. I also enjoy the fact you can adjust the snooze time and the duration of the alarm.

I wear hearing aids in both ears and am deaf when they are out. The clock has a beep you can set high pitch. low pitch or in between. It also has flashing red lights and comes with a bed shaker to put under your pillow. It also has a snooze button you can program for different lengths of time. With my hearing loss it is great to be able to get up in the morning with the help of this clock!

reviews.title: Great product.
reviews.review_text: I love this sonic clock. My grandson has autism and I have been having a problem trying to potty train him at night and his doctor recommended that I should get one of these bed wetting alarm clock and it only took me about 4days to fully get him potty trained at night. He was already potty durning the day.

reviews.title: This Sonic Alert Bomb Clock will wake you up!
reviews.review_text: This clock does the job! I even have used it for a timer. Sometimes, I wear headphones on the computer and get so involved in what I'm doing I can't hear a normal timer. The add feature of a vibrator disk can be tucked into the side of the chair or placed on the desk. No more burnt rice! :)

reviews.title: So many wasted years looking and not buying this.
reviews.review_text: I love... love ..... LOVE this clock! I'm a life long heavy sleeper. My family jokes that i can sleep through anything. Well, I have to work and many times have had to rely on them waking me. This clock changed the game. Waste no more time and get this alarm system. Fair warning though the vibration disk is amped up. It will definitely wake you.

reviews.title: Terrible reliability!
reviews.review_text: This Clock did not operate. Opened package, everything looked fine. Set time and alarm one day. Tested Fine! The next morning, clock alarm never sounded. Investigated to discover only 3 red lights visible - not time - no display. Attempted to get display back unsuccessfully. I immediately returned to nearest Walmart.

reviews.title: Works extremely well
reviews.review_text: Easy to read at night. The shaker does the job. Even with only 40% hearing in one ear and 60% in the other there is no need for the audible alarm. The only complaint is that the back up battery attachment apparently has a broken wire. The B/U battery will not operate. I had to leave quickly on a trip and did not have the time to wait for a new one to be shipped out. Other than that, I would recommend this item

reviews.title: It really really works!
reviews.review_text: I bought this for a hearing impaired friend who has had trouble getting up on time. They also have a tendency to fall back to sleep. Now they wake up on time and stay awake. The the clock is easy to set and adjust. The shaker is very strong. I like that the clock also has LED lights that flash when the alarm goes off. The clock also has an audible alarm that can be used. The volume of the audio alarm can be adjusted from very low to very loud. It has a very nice test mode feature which came in handy for setting up the unit. I also used it to show my friend what to expect when the alarm goes off. In case of a power outage, it has battery backup to keep the time. I don't think the alarm part will function if it is only running on the battery. The battery was not included so you should plan on getting one when you purchase this clock. Overall, I am very pleased with the product and I expect to get many years of use from it.

reviews.title: Life saving alarm clock
reviews.review_text: This alarm clock saved my job! I was having trouble getting up for work and it got to the point that I got written up and was told I would be fired if I continued to be late. I bought this alarm clock and never again have I slept through my alarm. This thing does its job the way an alarm clock should. Well worth the investment.

reviews.title: Excellent for over-sleepers!
reviews.review_text: Awesome alarm. I only use the vibration and I haven’t missed an alarm yet…except when I make the conscious decision to turn off the alarm, which is maybe why the further you can put it away from your sleepy reach, the better. The vibe is super strong, through my mattress topper it feels like a gentle massage, and it definitely wakes you no matter what.

reviews.title: Nice and LOUD

reviews.title: when you need to wake up
reviews.review_text: Wow! it wakes the dead! it is great! If you can't hear your old alarm very well because you're deaf like me, you will hear this alarm. Try the buzzer/ viberater under your pillow, I'm sure that will work. Its well worth the money.

reviews.title: Wakes my ugly self up!
reviews.review_text: I have had this a few months now and I can honestly say it has woke me up every morning. I have sleep apnea and due to a car accident I have to take a lot of painkillers including Morphine and Percocet and they make me sleep very soundly with the sleep apnea machine. This thing cuts through the deep sleep and wakes me up every time. One of the nice features is that it allows you to adjust the tone and volume so I so mine to the loudest volume and the tone I find most annoying and coupled with the vibration unit it effectively wakes me up every day. If I had one complaint it would be that it should not have a snooze button on it, not a good thing for those that have a hard time getting up.

reviews.title: Good, but not great.
reviews.review_text: When I ordered this, I was so excited because I could not wake up in time for my first job. I work 7-11, go to school 12-3:30, then work 5-10:30, so I needed something that would kick me in the face at 6a.m. Needless to say, this clock did this until about 2 weeks in. After that, the pillow vibrator had become useless. My body just quit allowing it to affect me. Then the alarm stopped waking me up. I changed the tone of it in hopes that the reason behind my not waking up was the fact that my body had become custom to the sound. Unfortunately, this was not the case. Another downfall of the clock was the looks. The shape is ridiculous, and the colors are even more so. There is another one with the exact same specifications, with the exceptions of the looks, and it cost $10.00 more. I know I seem really negative in the review, but the clock is the loudest I have heard. 113db may be a stretch, but it is loud. I think the problem lies in my lifestyle, as opposed to the clock. However, I believe this clock was created for people in similar situations, i.e. moms that raise kids and work. Anyway, take this as you will.

reviews.title: So happy with the alarm clock
reviews.review_text: This is so wonderful my child has a vary hard time waking up and with the sound a vibrating opson were we can do both wored so grate to get her up. I stuck the vibration part under her fited sheet and put the alarm clock out of reach of her hands so she has to get up to turn it off. Normal alarm clocks never worked for her I'm so happy this duse. I'm planing to get one for me too becuse I'm losing my hearing and it will surely help me get up also!!

reviews.title: Very positive!
reviews.review_text: It was easy to set up and I am pleased with the alarm and the vibrating device. It works quite well under the pillow. Since my mattress is quite thick, I was unable to use it there. The alarm volume can be set at a VERY loud setting - amazing! I will never be late again!

reviews.title: Does Not Work - No Reliability
reviews.review_text: The purpose of an alarm clock is to wake you. This clock is loud enough, but it never works reliably enough that you can depend on it. After just 2 months the error codes started appearing. The clock would work sometimes but not every day as it should. I returned it for another one of the same model - same thing happened. This clock is a good concept - but it doesn't work. Do not buy this piece of junk.

reviews.title: Finally an alarm that works!
reviews.review_text: I purchased this alarm clock as a gift for my son who is a deep sleeper. He has slept thru hurricanes, multiple alarm clocks and cell phone calls, texts and alarms, nothing seemed to work to wake him. Till now. He said that it is the most annoying thing ever, and he jumps up out of bed to turn it off so that the neighbors do not mistake it for a fire alarm! LOL For him to says that it works great speaks for itself as he has tried many methods to wake up in the morning to no avail. Finally an alarm that gets the job done, don't hesitate to purchase this alarm clock if you or someone you love has difficulty waking to regular alarm clocks.

reviews.title: Problem solver for waking a deep sleeper!
reviews.review_text: My 10 year old daughter is a very deep sleeper. She is also hearing impaired in one ear. Therefore, regular alarm clocks don't always work when she needs to wake up for school. After using this alarm clock on only the vibrating alarm placed under her pillow (don't need the sound), it has worked amazing. A little pricey especially since it doesnt even have a radio included (there is one available that does but I couldnt justify paying $20 more for that option), but it does its job.

reviews.title: Great Vibrating alarm clock
reviews.review_text: This alarm clock really works. I have always had a hard time waking up and sometimes sleeping through other alarm clocks. I put it under my pillow and it shakes and vibrates so much that it definitely wakes me up. Very glad I bought this alarm clock.

reviews.title: This alarm is a good purchase.
reviews.review_text: This clock is VERY loud. However, I would not compare it to a jackhammer. I read a lot of discriptions and reviews before I bought it and I am the exception to the guareented to wake one up. "I CAN still sleep through the noise" even though the neighbors might be hearing it. I hear fine when I'm awake. I must sleep really deep. I actually thought it might be louder (that's why not 5 stars). I sleep next to a noisy window air conditioner and with the television on. What does wake me up and get me going is the bedshaker. I slip it into my pillowcase and that seems to do the trick for me. I thought the bedshaker would scare me awake but it isn't that radical or it may be the way I'm positioning it. This alarm is a good buy, well worth the money and the loudest I've ever heard. A little disappointed in the cheesy quality of the plastic (that's also why not 5 stars). It doesn't have a durable feel. That was the first thing I noticed when taking it out of the box besides the aweful plastic smell from the inside packaging. I hope it lasts a long while. Being able to adjust the tone is a great feature for me becuase if I get used to hearing the same noise morning after morning it tends to not disturb me after a while. This way I can change the pitch to mix it up a litte and keep it fresh.

reviews.title: I loooooooooove it!!!
reviews.review_text: The shipping was on time, AWESOME! I wake up fast once it vibrates, feels like an earthquake LOL! BTW, I'm deaf :) I don't have to wake up every hour during night time to check the time on my iPhone WHOO HOO!!! Even more, it has TWO alarm sets, PERFECT :) Again, I loooooooooove it!!! I'm a Wal-Mart freak haha!

Fabulous!!! I purchaased 2 clocks in a store that advertised them as "loud alarm". They were not loud for me. After research was referred to a truck stop that carried a model clock especially for truck drivers and purchased one. It proved to be effective in waking me, but a bit difficult to learn how to set it. This clock did not last one year and was back to the truck stop to purchase another, but was told they no longer carred this brand. The price was comparable to the Sonic Alert. How lucky am I to find this on line at Walmart!! After reading the details on all "loud alarm clocks", I chose the Sonic Alert Boom Alarm. I am absolutely thrilled with its performance. Since I am hard of hearing, must have a dependable clock. As yet, have not used the shaker because don't need it. The design and performance exceeds expectations, and the price is "icing on the cake". Don't hesitate about choosing the Sonic Alert!

reviews.title: BOOM
reviews.review_text: Got it for my wife,the vibrator wakes us both,with the volume set on low.I cannot imagine needing a more powerfull alarm.I was looking for a battery powered clock,but the back up fills our concern about loosing power during the night.All controls are EZ to see and locate when waking up,I like the large time display and use it for a night light.I would reccommend this clock to any hard to wake sleeper.

reviews.title: Deep Sleeper's Alarm Clock
reviews.review_text: The Sonic Boom Alarm Clock is great. I am a deep sleeper and can sleep through my cell phone alarm clock. I could have gotten a stereo system since they can be louder but this is cheaper and figure I would give this a try. It does help with the vibrations under my pillow. Almost sounds like a semi backing up with alert system and you can adjust the sound so it makes a faded or clear alert system. The vibrations are not very comfortable so don't worry about sleeping through the vibrations. You wake up instantly but you can easily fall back asleep from the snooze button. It comes back on so that is good. Haven't timed the snooze button yet. There is a button on the back that you can adjust that sets at (USA)12 hour at 60hz, (UK)12 hour 50hz, (Europe)24 hours at 50 hz. There are 4 adjustment settings on it. Buzz and or vibrate. High or low vibrations. Buzz sounds faded or not so faded. High or low buzz sounds. There is a square battery to put in the back to store the set times which will be great in the storms during summer. I plan on getting another one or two just in case they stop selling this. Don't forget AM or PM settings on it!!! lol

reviews.title: Great alarm clock for the deep sleeper
reviews.review_text: My son is 12 and would sleep through his alarm every morning. He had 2 alarms going off approx. 10 inches from his head and slept straight through it for a half hour till I woke him. 1st morning with the Sonic Boom and he was up right away and on time for school!! I would have never believed it if I hadn't seen it. I didn't think there was an alarm to wake him cause he is such a deep sleeper, but this does. Very pleased!!!

reviews.title: Deep Sleeper?
reviews.review_text: I am probably the deepest sleeper you can think of. I once slept through a hurricane, and thunder storms don't phase me. This alarm clock wakes me up EVERY time. Lights flash, the buzzer is loud enough, and the bed shakes. The ONLY drawback to this clock is the fact that the snooze bar only works for an hour. I am chronic about hitting that sucker, and one hour is not uncommon for me to hit it. The snooze deactivates after one hour. The only other improvements I would make from a design aspect would be 2 things. One, make the buzzer more like the sound of an emergency vehicle coming through, because that subconciously affects everybody. Two, I would have the bed shaker a revolving off center motor to be more effective and realistic for a wave effect. However, for the money, this is a VERY good alarm clock (only) and I highly recommend it for heavy sleepers.

reviews.title: It didn't work !
reviews.review_text: I ordered this purchase on line, paid by credit card, requested delivery to store (Whitinsville, Ma), waited one week for it's delivery to the store. -- The delivery and notification system went well. -I picked it up at the store when notified and brought it home. It was well-packaged. All of the required apparatus was present and in apparently good condition. It simply didn't work! I mean -it didn't ring, the vibrator didn't vibrate -- it didn't even light up. (Yes, it was plugged in and connected properly!) -- Unfortunately, I returned it to the store. I have a substantial hearing loss and had hoped that, at last, an alarm clock that was capable of waking me was available. --Unfortunately, that was not the case !

reviews.title: A godsend
reviews.review_text: Our son is a senior in high school and still could not get himself up in the morning. We tried several different alarm clocks but nothing seemed to work. I finally googled "extra loud alarm clocks" and quickly found that Sonic Alert was THE brand for deep sleepers. The Sonic Bomb is loud (claims 113db) and also has a disk to go under the mattress or pillow that vibrates very violently. Between the sound and the vibrating disk, he has gotten up on his own ever since we got it. I'm only sorry we didn't discover this product sooner, say when he was in middle school- would have saved many rough mornings in our house. Anyhow, he has it now, and we can send him off to college in the fall without having to worry about whether he'll get up for class or not.

reviews.review_text: WOW... I wanted a loud alarm that is what the Sonic is. One guy here said it wasn't loud enough. It has a volume control. To set anything you have to pick it up to steady it, but the shape is awkward; slips out of your hand easily. However, it has lots of tricks like two alarms and they are 24 hour type, though not day settable. When the alarm sounds slap it on the top and shuts off for 7 minutes then back on. Even has a bed shaker! So, not so pretty, a bit clumsy to set, but it will wake the dead. Even has a tone adjustment so that while awake you can adjust the tone to the most disturbing for you. The time numbers are huge with adjustable brightness. The clock itself is a night light and its brightness is adjustable too. Any big flaw? Yep, if the electric goes off the time keeps working, but not its display and not the alarm. jimD

I took the clock out of the box, and the first thing I did was install a brand new 9V battery in the back. Nothing happened; it didn't turn on. While both the battery and the alarm clock were fresh out of their respective boxes, I did test the battery to make sure it was indeed fresh. It was, so I removed the cord from the box and plugged this alarm in to the outlet. It worked fine, but I immediately returned it to my local store because of the issue with the faulty battery connector. I do not know if I will order another one. I will wait and see.

Thinking maybe I could outsmart this irritating piece of subpar junk, I set alarm to compensate for the time it skipped the night before. It woke me up 20 minutes late. I have had this alarm for four days now and it CANNOT KEEP TIME. It's not even consistant with the time it skips. I've returned this and will be ordering something else.

This includes my husband, my 3 yr old and me. I don't know what to say I mean the vibration is pretty strong but I guess we just sleep too hard. The buzzer is supposedly this extremely loud, high decibel alert.....but I do not hear it. So if you are a hard, deep sleeper and you purchase this clock make sure you keep the box for a week or two and try it out first. I made the mistake of throwing mine out and now I am stuck with an overpriced clock that is very unattractive in appearance for my bedroom. Oh well.

reviews.title: Ring light makes a huge difference!
reviews.review_text: Omg y'all this ring light makes all the difference it is so awesome! I've always wondered how the people on the youtube videos I watch look so good with nice skin and all...This is their secret! I love this ring light. I found set up to be super easy and didn't really need the instructions. I love that you can plug it into a wall outlet or if you are on the go you can use a usb plug to power it with your phone or power bank or whatever..note the power cord is included the usb cord is not. It comes with its own little storage bag making it compact and easy to store or travel with. The tripod is super easy to adjust and in the picture I included I have two segments of the tripod fully extended and it is taller than me, I'm around 4'10" so with the third segment fully extended it's even taller than me. There is a holder that you assemble and attach to hold your phone, you can set it to hold you phone sideways or straight up and down depending on how you assemble it and there are slots on the inside and outside of the ring light that you can put it in. I love that you can adjust the light to cool or warm as well as adjust the brightness. This thing is bright enough to light up my living room when I turn the lights out and it's the only thing on. The difference it makes in videos and pictures is amazing I love it. The only thing that could possibly make it better is if there was a button on the remote to make your phone take a picture but I don't use the remote anyway as it's not really needed. The buttons for on and off both turn it on and off also there is a button that says neutral...it does not set the light to neutral light it makes the light pulse off and on..the more you push it the more setting it cycles threw as in pulse, flash, etc. So if you have a light flash sensitivity don't use the neutral button.

reviews.title: Wow!! What a difference
reviews.review_text: My first ring light. Wow!! What difference, should have gotten one of these a long time ago. If you find you’re not as photogenic as you would like to be while video chatting, you should give one of these a shot. I plan to use this for video chats with friends and family and telehealth appointments from now on. So easy to set up. Another avenue I want to explore is how I can improve the pics and videos of the caterpillars from our butterfly garden. Occasionally we bring some inside to raise while they transform from caterpillars to chrysalis to butterflies. I’m positive the ring light will be a valuable tool. It’s lightweight and easy to transport in the soft sided carry case which is provided. The stand is adjustable from 16.9 to 63 inches and pretty sturdy. It’s made of metal on the bottom with plastic poles. The cord is fairly long and a power supply box is included. The manual is more like a pamphlet and could be more detailed especially concerning the remote control. The remote is touchy and I’m still trying to figure out how to adjust the light settings with it, which vary from warm to cool and in degrees of brightness. However the light unit itself has buttons on the back to control the light settings so you don’t have to use the remote. There are also four places to mount your phone to the light unit using the bendable phone holder for more angles. I would recommend this set if you are looking for a larger ring light as it is a generous 18 inches and a good value for the price.

One part was missing-- the piece that connects the light to the tripod. I plugged in the light and was happy with the even coverage and the two switches for adjustments. The remote control (requires 2 AAA batteries) functioned well. I suggest a potential buyer open the box in the store to verify that all parts and the instruction manual are there before purchasing.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.review_text: This is my second purchase of this item. I first came across this item during a Black Friday sale in 2021. I was so excited with how this product functioned!! After a move in late 2023 I decided to purchase a second one to go along with the original. To my disappointment there's a short in the port for the adapter, the holder for the phone is inoperable. I've DIY my own way to still be able to utilize the LED Light itself being as though that was the main point of purchase. Overall great lighting. Still recommend.

reviews.title: Very ease to use!
reviews.review_text: This ring light set is absolutely amazing. The brightness level is great and can be adjusted according to your liking. I love taking pictures, so this works wonderfully in my bedroom. It definitely makes such a huge difference in pictures and videos. It's also quite easy to set up! I love that it comes with a carrying case, makes it easy to carry it anywhere you want to go. I love that the stand can be adjusted as well, can be used when I'm sitting down or standing up. I highly recommend!

reviews.title: Better Lighting = Better Video Calls
reviews.review_text: I am not a social media celebrity or anything, so I thought this would be useless to me. I planned on giving as a gift after I tried it. Boy was I surprised! When used for video chatting, it adds immediacy and intimacy to the conversation. At first, I thought it was coincidence that my conversations went better, but now I'm convinced that good lighting makes a huge improvement in my ability to communicate. My phone and smaller tablet fit perfectly but laptops and larger tablets will not. DSLR cameras or anything with UNC threading on the bottom will attach just fine. Height and angle adjustment were great and the tripod is quality. It's a little difficult to setup, but thankfully you only have to do that once. It has a light warmth setting but the warmest setting is not as red as I would like. It is also EXTREMELY bright. Even on the low setting it can be fatiguing to the eyes after an extended conversation. I would not recommend to anyone with glasses due to glare. Overall, this is a great product and useful even if you are not trying to be an influencer.

The instructions are horrible. I don’t like that the stand becomes unstable the higher you adjusted it. I had to remove the case from my phone and open the phone holder up to the widest length just to fit my phone into the device; I have an iPhone 11 plus. The legs are unstable and do not lock into place if you have it at a higher height. The one thing I liked is the remote control; make sure you have batteries, it doesn’t come with it. I’ve used it once and I’ll try once more to see if it’s worth keeping or returning.

reviews.title: I was sad it didn't work for me
reviews.review_text: I went ahead and returned it. Unfortunately, the screw must have been made with a very flimsy metal: every time I screwed the top back on, it would come loose and the metal would shave off/push down leaving no ridges in the screw. As a result of it coming loose, it fell off a few times, had I not caught it, it definitely could have been a hazard. All of this happened the same night, wish I loved it and kept it as I definitely need a good ring light, sadly, this was not it. Walmart is processing my refund as we speak. I appreciate how low-hassle it was.

It was hard to find a ring light that just went into a moral outlet instead if a usb. And the carrying case was a surprise bonus. But I did return this because I thought the remote was to take pictures like a lot of the other ones. I purchased this this to take our Christmas pictures and needed the remote to snap the pics.

reviews.title: Light Ring

Only glare is with my glasses, but that's with any light. Easily moved around my house, and it comes with a travel bag. The USB port charges my phone without any problems. reviews.title: Absolutely Delightful Unit (back for a 2nd!)
reviews.review_text: We were lucky to pick this up when it was on sale and I'm back to buy another at full price! I got this for “creator stuff” but we quickly adapted it for use as a light in our living room! 😅 We kinda like the look of it— vibes with our LR's theme lol—and it provides a substantial amount of light that I can tune to the natural light. Very bright light! It's positioned so it fires up into the corner of the room. This is not a lighting system that will feel “modern”, it will feel like the design is from 10-15 years ago. That's expected for a light this powerful at this price point. Keeping the price point out in mind we move to the build quality. I do not have training in the art of tripodlightotry so please forgive the terminology I must use ☺️ The tripod uses friction to hold each level of telescopingly-friendly extensions. Each lavel has a flappy-boi on the outside. When that boi is opened, the friction is disengaged and the extensions can slide freebally. To propose to friction, you first keep the extension at the desired height, get down on one knee, and close the flappy-boi. This system has its flaws and for some would be the dealbreaker 😢 The friction is not great and I had to shimmy some cardboard around the extensions so as to provide some more emotional stability for friction. The system for changing the angle of the head is straightforward and surprisingly durable however it's a little loose. I added a washer and it has been perfect. Don't over-tighten or it could snap. Iirc, the USB port is 2.1a 10w. It didn't know the power output before I bought it so I was surprised. We use it to charge many things throughout the day! The camera connection equipment doesn't include any of those stupid “ball %26 socket with threaded collar” features. It's not perfect but it's more secure than those BS systems. The remote control is…OK, it's big than some of the other lights in this price point; it doesn't have a “credit card style” remote control. It's bulkier and uses I think AAA or AA batteries. It just makes sense to be with this unit. Once you setup the light, secure the flappy-bois, and plug in the heavy AC adaptor—it's an old school two-piecer— you'll know exactly what I mean 😊 I would recommend this light!

Very happy with my purchase! The wall shelves arrived well-packaged, with all the screws and parts included, and the material feels sturdy and high-quality. the stencil for drilling holes in my wall was evidently for a larger set of shelves. The mounting brackets were 8 3/16"apart. The stencil was for a set with a 10" span between the brakets. I made the mistake of not checking first, so I had holes to patch and unreuseable hardware. The second set had no stencil at all.

reviews.title: Hardware is trash
reviews.review_text: The hardware was awful, so it was impossible for the shelves to hold anything without falling off. The reason I gave 2 stars instead of 1 is because I decided to purchase shelf brackets and used those instead. Otherwise, the shelves would have ended up in the trash. I had to spend a little more money, but they look nice and are very sturdy with this modification.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.review_text: Vague instructions. Poor design makes it very difficult to get the shelves sturdy. I've never had an issue installing or assembling things around the house, and I wanted to throw these shelves in the trash. Installation was beyond frustrating. I got the shelves installed, but they do not sit perfectly flush with the wall, so anything cylindrical would roll forward off the shelf. I do not recommend this product whatsoever.

The packaging was really nice. Unfortunately, the shelves aren't. They won't stay up. Maybe that's because I had to hang them up a little differently because I didn't have a drill, but I'm not sure. I genuinely can't tell if it's my fault that they're so unstable or not. The nails are in the wall, but the shelves refuse to stay. Well, one shelf does, but that's probably because I never touch that one. The other shelf is very flimsy. You have to be VERY gentle with it or it will fall. Actually, the one shelf just fell a few minutes ago while I was laying in bed, NOT TOUCHING it. That's what inspired me to make this review. I'm going to try and see if maybe I can reinforce the shelf with a command strip or two... but as it is now, I can't recommend these shelves. One positive is, though, that the instruction manual was clear and conceive. As I said earlier, the packaging was also nice. I just wish the actual product was good, too.

Buying the item was the biggest hurrdle, let me explain why. i ordered online to get picked up the next day, next day comes around then got an email saying 1 of the 2 that i ordered was unavailable and that i could get the other shipped to my home for free. I was ok with that so i clicked the option to get it shipped and Walmart site tells me that my address is unavailable for delivery, hmmm that's interesting because I've had items shipped to my house before with no issues, so i contact my local walmart to pick up the 1 items that they did have and they tell me that they don't have anything ready for me so they give me a 1 800 number to call. I proceed to call the number which the person that answered was amazingly friendly and helpful. They were able to get the items shipped to me for free for next day delivery, well thats not the end of it. i did recieve the item next day, but only half the order, so i called the 1-800 number again, which i was greeted with the most polite person ever and they said my order got split into 2 deliveries for some reason and that i should get it later today, i was like ok, awesome that sounds good! it didn't get delivered until the next day :( , so something that took minutes to order ended up with me having to spend extra time to get things squared away and finally get my item. Yeah i know first world problems go cry me a river bla bla bla. but listen if a store offered these options then people expect their items that was promised at a certain time and no i couldn't just go to the store i get them myself cause it was unavailable at the store and was only available through online only at this time because they had run out of stock on the floor.

reviews.title: Impressive refrigerator
reviews.review_text: We are senior citizens. We had a 31-year-old Amana. We did extensive research to decide on a replacement. Boy, are we happy to have chosen Frigidaire. It is very spacious; the doors can hold a lot of bottled groceries, and the vegetable drawers are high enough to hold a big cabbage or lettuce. I love all the different compartments in the freezer drawer. Every item has its place, eliminating guesswork. More importantly, the appliance fits in the very tight space we had. Thank you Fridgidaire.

reviews.title: Great interior space!
reviews.review_text: I replaced a Samsung with larger exterior dimensions, with this Frigidaire, and find that the interior of this fridge has way more space! Very happy with this purchase. And very affordable. Will most likely upgrade more appliances with this brand.

reviews.title: Counter depth is a game changer
reviews.review_text: I bought this model a month ago, and the highlights of this model are: Space Efficiency: This model is designed to fit flush with my pantry, providing a sleek, built-in look, and added space into the kitchen. Large Capacity: Despite its counter-depth design, it offers ample storage with wide shelves and deep drawers, making it ideal for my cooking enthusiasm. Advanced Cooling Technology: Features like EvenTemp™ cooling system ensures consistent temperatures throughout the fridge, reducing freezer burn and keeping food fresh. Energy Efficiency: Frigidaire refrigerators are known for their energy-efficient designs, helping me save on electricity bills while being environmentally friendly. Convenient Features: Additional features like ice makers, and advanced water filtration. I'm still excited about this fridge, but I have a small disappointment regarding the rebate. The 30-inch model I purchased is listed as a non-eligible item, so the rebate is on hold. I'm not sure if I will receive the $100 rebate. Nonetheless, it is a fantastic fridge!

reviews.title: Great fridge for the spacd
reviews.review_text: So far so good. We've had this fridge for about a month and really like it. We had a difficult time finding a fridge to fit the width and depth of the space in the cabinets and this one's great for those smaller spaces. The inside is quite spacious for a counter depth fridge. The only issue is the floor models in stores had the scoop for the ice maker and we didn't receive one with our fridge.

reviews.title: Good Fridge Overall, but Some Issues After a Few Months
reviews.review_text: I've had this refrigerator since December 10, 2024, and overall, I really like it. It's my first time owning a two-door model with the refrigerator on the bottom, and the storage capacity is more than enough for my needs. Problem: In the past week, I've noticed that the right door doesn't close tightly anymore. I have to push it firmly to make sure it's sealed, as if the magnetic seal isn't holding as well as it used to. I have no idea why this issue suddenly started, so I'll need to check the warranty. Cons: The ice maker makes a terrible noise, so I keep it disabled. Suggested improvements: I would love to see an extra drawer dedicated to cheeses and deli meats, as well as a light inside the freezer.

reviews.title: Mostly good!
reviews.review_text: I bought it mainly because it's counter depth. It's a pretty basic fridge. For the money, I would've expected a couple of extra features…. reviews.title: Perfect fit for the house
reviews.review_text: I recently purchased a Frigidaire refrigerator, and I couldn't be happier with my choice! The sleek design fits perfectly in my kitchen, giving it a modern and stylish look. It's not just about aesthetics—the performance is outstanding. The cooling system keeps everything fresh for longer, and the spacious interior is thoughtfully designed to maximize storage. I especially love the adjustable shelves, which make organizing groceries a breeze. The energy efficiency is another bonus—it's both eco-friendly and budget-friendly. Frigidaire truly delivers a perfect blend of functionality, quality, and style. Highly recommend it to anyone in need of a reliable and elegant fridge!

reviews.title: Well Thought Out

We don't have a water connection so this is something that down the road we could attach but aren't required. It even has the option to turn it off or on. Space wise for the size of the fridge it makes good use of the space provided and everything inside is well lite. Very modern and the material seems fairly strong. Metal isn't thin or flimsy. Overall we are pleased with the unit and the price was fantastic.

Putting in the door shelves was a challenge as they are tight (which means they won't fall out) but we were worried about breaking them since they are plastic and a lot of force is needed to snap them in. The fridge has a lot of space for a 32” but it lacks a dedicated space for eggs - so we just leave them in the cartons. Overall we like the fridge and we doubt it will last as long as our last fridge did - 22 years and still going - but that may be too much to expect - newer appliances don't seem to be made like they were in the past.

We enjoy the large basins as well. We have a two year old who loves hanging off the lower handle for the freezer. The handle holds up well.

reviews.title: Good Fit
reviews.review_text: The fridge was the right height and width for our restricted space. I like the fridge above to avoid bending and there is plenty of space inside. I would have liked a dedicated meat drawer. Getting the drawers installed in the doors was tricky. I would have liked a paper manual with clearer instructions rather than having to go online. Generally the fridge is quiet but occasionally makes a louder sound as it tries to access ice-making (we didn't hook that up). The freezer section has pull-out drawers that allow for ease of organization. Looks shiny and enhances our kitchen.

reviews.title: Fantastic little fridge
reviews.review_text: Our freezer stopped working on our old fridge so we needed to buy a new one pretty quickly. This one was perfect as counter-depth as our old one was too large for our small kitchen. Love the three drawers in the freezer. Only complaint is there is no "cheese" drawer and the crisper drawers are smaller than what we had previously. So far 1 month in the fridge works fantastic. Just be careful with the manual as ours was missing information on how to set the fridge temperature.

reviews.title: Great fridge
reviews.review_text: I bought this a month ago and so far am quite pleased with it. My old fridge came with the house and was well over twenty years old - it was a fabulous fridge and held a LOT of stuff. New fridges now are designed quite differently and seem far less spacious. The things I like most about this fridge is the layout. Without the extra crisper drawer, there is a ton more room to put taller items - all other fridges you are pretty much limited to the door. So far it runs well and is reasonably quiet. I like the counter depth as it blends well and doesn't stick out into the room - though that does compromise somewhat on the holding capacity, which is fine for my home. I would have preferred to not have the ice maker as I can't connect to water and it's a waste of space. The freezer drawer layout works well though, and it's nice to organize the compartments. Overall it's a great fridge and I'm very pleased with it.
