reviews.title: Fits in perfectly!
reviews.review_text: I just bought the fridge about three weeks ago and it's working like a charm right out of the box. The overall look is terrific and the features I've used so far have been first rate. The refrigeration area is large and can accommodate quite a bit of food which came in handy during the holiday season. The freezer compartment is also voluminous but a bit cut up which makes it a bit tricky if you have more than a few large items (a turkey, a ham and a box of frozen puff pastries on top of all the everyday items). It's a good thing we're experts as Tetris. So far, it's been all we really needed.

reviews.title: Good but smallish for a family of four.
reviews.review_text: Very cute little fridge. Simple, elegant, high quality, and cleanly laid out. Manageable for a family of four but is smaller than our old fridge which had 25 cubic feet so we're still getting used to the smaller size. Love the style and simplicity. Also love the interior lighting. Everything looks like it's in the middle of a photo shoot. My only caveats are that the left door's vertically hinged seal doesn't alway open all the way, so closing the left door sometimes gets caught, slamming against the right. Also there is sometimes is a loud clunking sound on the bottom left side when opening the freezer drawer. Other than that we find it very cute and endearing and hope it will last with us for the next decade or so. Cheers!

reviews.title: Very happy with my 17.6 cu ft. fridge
reviews.review_text: We needed a smaller sized fridge to fit inside the cabinet opening. Surprisingly, this new fridge seems to be roomier inside and holds more than our previously larger one. We've only had it for a few weeks but so far we have no issues with it. It looks great too! I wish a hard copy user manual was provided though. I'm not fond of downloading a pdf version. I'm praying this fridge lasts as long as our 21 year old Kenmore did.

reviews.title: Superior quality, excellent reliability and terrific day to day home use
reviews.review_text: I purchased this approximately a month ago, as a replacement to my previous Frigidaire that lasted forever. I purchased a new Frigidaire because I wanted to refresh my old refrigerator. Knowing that Frigidaire is one of the highest quality appliance companies out there, I did not hesitate to purchase this. Money was no issue. I could have purchased another brand, but knowing that Frigidaire is ranked as one of the best, I did not hesitate to purchase this French Door Counter-Depth Frigidaire. Just by look alone, the french door concept is the way to go for any family. There is no need to bend down constantly looking for product when using the original style top freezer design fridges. I am 100 percent glad I went with the french door, and have no hesitation recommended everyone look into this type of space saving design. Bottom line. A+ design and quality. The sizing is perfect for any home. Take a look at the picture I uploaded and get a sense of the beauty that will soon be yours.

reviews.title: Great features
reviews.review_text: The appearance: the change from a white fridge to a silver/grey is aesthetically pleasing Inside: the openness - the ability to quickly see where things are - the awesome storage options on the two doors the depth is good - things aren't lost at the back or timely to dig out, a problem with my old fridge The fridge operates quietly and efficiently. However, it doesn't have as much storage space in the two crispers as my previous fridge and as a nutritionally motivated individual, this is an area that I rely upon.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.review_text: I was disappointed that I had such a small space to work with in my new kitchen. I was really hoping to avoid a 30 inch fridge and found this slightly bigger Frigidaire. I was pleasantly surprised by the layout in both the fridge and freezer components. This fridge is a very good option, if you're working with a small opening

reviews.title: Great appliance!
reviews.review_text: We bought ours a month ago for our new house and we love it! From the layout of the shelves keeping everything organized and easily accessible so nothing gets left at the back to go bad, to the convenient 3 drawer freezer with ice maker. Great choice for sure!

reviews.title: Working great and looks great too.
reviews.review_text: We have had the Frigidaire fridge for about one month. It is working great and the interior layout makes for good visibility of your items. I love the different drawers in the freezer compartment and the ice maker is working well. The fingerprint free surface is great for nice clean look on the exterior.

reviews.title: Fine
reviews.review_text: I bought this fridge because it was one of only three fridges that fit the space allotted. I am very disappointed that a manual was included. I tried to obtain one online but got lost in the maze of websites. It has a ice maker which I have no idea about, nor how to install it. If you actually read this review please send me a manual.

reviews.title: Perfect for our small kitchen
reviews.review_text: We purchased our fridge just over a week ago. We were loving everything about it until yesterday when we noticed the clear drawers in the freezer section were getting a fine film of frost on them. The temperature was set at zero so we lowered it to -2 degrees and today the frost has gone!

reviews.title: Great deal
reviews.review_text: Perfect size for my kitchen. Doors swing nice and close great. Shelves are easy to install and adjust. The controls are simple and easy to see. The freezer is a nice size and the drawer is a nice feature. The ice machine is compact and the perfect size for my application. Nice fridge and great price!

reviews.title: New fridge
reviews.review_text: I purchased this refrigerator a month ago and have nothing but good to say about it. The size is perfect for me, being counter depth and with excellent shelf placement options and large door shelving. But the selling feature for me was the layout of the freezer with multiple drawers to maximize the space access, along with the ice cube maker and tray.

reviews.title: I Love our new Refrigerator...Fantastic Choice
reviews.review_text: This is the first Frigidaire I have ever purchased. We purchased it for about 1 month ago. It fit perfectly, looks great and works extremely well. We love the LED lighting and the large doors along with the large freeze compartment located at the bottom. I am sold on this refrigerator and would highly recommend it to others.

reviews.title: Fridge works well, but beware very short power cord
reviews.review_text: I bought this fridge a little over a month ago and it has been working really well. My biggest complaint is that the power cord is very short. If you need to pull out your fridge because it is in a close out on both sides, you can't without removing the side wall/close out. Every other fridge I have owned has at least 1.5X longer power cord. It is a little small inside (not very deep) especially if you don't utilize the door storage. There is no light in the freezer area, but it's something you can get used to. Freezer area space is also pretty limited by the ice maker taking up space in the top left corner and the ice catcher. All that said, it is working well, fairly quiet and seemingly reliable if the power cord length is not an issue for your kitchen set up

reviews.title: Excellent for counter depth and limited width!
reviews.review_text: The self closing door feature stops the door about 5 inches away then if you push slightly on the door it will close on it's own from there. The flipper mullion will occasionally hit the adjacent door when closing if you don't flip it back a bit further manually. The compressor has a loud cycle that runs for a short time a few times a day. Nice looking unit, easy to access, great interior lighting, practical shelf location adjustments to suit our needs, big milk jug shelves on the door are great although it's a bit tricky to get them into the lower middle position, dual crispers are easy to access, the multiple freezer drawers make it easy to manage the contents, ice maker is handy. I haven't stopped and gave it a hug yet. Overall great product.

reviews.title: Best Chill Appliance
reviews.review_text: I needed to replace my refrigerator quickly. The Frigidaire - 17.6 Cu. Ft. Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator was the perfect fit for my small space, yet gives me all the room I need for food storage. Love the clear bins and three-drawer freezer with ice-maker. French doors make easy access in a narrow galley kitchen.

reviews.title: Useful space
reviews.review_text: We love our new fridge space. Having compartments in both door allows you to organize your space so effectively. Sesame open up. Everything can be put in the right place and is easy to access. The lighting is also very good. The freezer compartment is also very functional. I highly recommend this model.

reviews.title: 17.6 Cu. Ft. Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator
reviews.review_text: I bought this fridge freezer after my previous Frigidaire packed in (after 22 years!). The appliance is a huge upgrade on our previous fridge freezer! I particularly like ease of use and the energy efficiency. Everything is so easy to reach in the fridge and freezer. We have recommended the appliance to our friends.

reviews.title: Nice fridge
reviews.review_text: Love the look of it but I find the shelves and the door bins fragile, makes me question the durability. It's not very large inside compared to the previous one we owned so we have to get used to that. I love the french door concept, helps seeing everything easily and not lose food as much as we use to. Like that the freezer contains so many drawers which helps with organizing but no light in freezer. We haven't connected the ice maker yet so can't comment on that at this point. Overall I'm happy with this purchase.

reviews.title: Great fridge, love that it's counter depth, lots of space inside and awesome icemaker!
reviews.review_text: The bad news was I had to replace my fridge last month but the good news is I got this great new fridge. Lots of space inside; I thought I'd miss not having a meat drawer however it's been totally fine. The produce drawers are large, the shelves are really easy to configure and there is a ton of space in the door shelves. I was a bit suprised there isn't a light in the freezer drawer however I really like the multi drawers and the icemaker.

reviews.title: Perfect Refrigerator
reviews.review_text: We are extremely pleased with our new refrigerator. Having the refrigerator part on the top half of the unit is so convenient with the freezer part on the bottom part. Really enjoying this feature of the refrigerator. Double French doors are also very convenient to open and close. Freezer compartment is spacious and we especially like the compartment (drawer) configuration. The appearance of the refrigerator is stunning. Overall, we are very satisfied with our purchase of this appliance. Thank you Frigidaire.

reviews.title: Fridge is good....but has some major drawbacks, kind of cheaped out
reviews.review_text: Many things I do not like, and was unaware when shopping for a new fridge until it was delivered. First off, the left door spring does not close and BANGS into the right side door. Secondly, really dislike LED lights, not a good look. Thirdly, THERE IS NO LIGHT IN THE FREEZER COMPARTMENT. WHO DOES THIS???? I need a flashlight at night to find anything. This brand is not what it used to be.....user documentation is either missing or cannot find it.

reviews.title: Very nice design and works great!
reviews.review_text: This refrigerator has great features and works great. I love the freezer at the bottom and the French doors as it allows me to open the refrigerator doors and not interfere with an island we have in the way. I just wish it would come equipped with a deli/meat drawer.

reviews.title: Frigidaire Fridge
reviews.review_text: I bought my fridge 3 months ago and since then I have been enjoying it. So far it is working perfectly.

reviews.title: refrigerator frfg1723av
reviews.review_text: I bought this refrigerator a month ago and really like it. The web site is total crap. I have not been able to get a single answer for any question that I have asked. Cannot even use the user manual without buying it.

reviews.title: Very pleased!
reviews.review_text: We love t this fridge. It fits like a glove in the space and still has tons of room for everything. Keeping it clean has not been an issue. Would reccomend!

reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.review_text: I have had this fridge for less then 6 months and the ice maker is not working. Still waiting for a repair man to come under the warranty. Been waiting over 3 weeks so far!

reviews.title: No manual
reviews.review_text: The refrigerator didn't come with a detailed manual, and I have no idea how to make changes in the software. The door shelves were difficult to install, so we didn't put them in for fear of breaking them.

reviews.title: Beautiful design
reviews.review_text: This fridge provides ample space and organization. If you have a small kitchen you will definitely appreciate the slimmer profile of this fridge. Also enjoying the ice maker!

reviews.title: Perfect Fit!
reviews.review_text: Bought this unit for our park model and love the fit and the features! The ice maker is awesome. Would have given it a five star rating but have had some food freezing at the back of fridge when temperature is set at recommended setting.

reviews.title: Super satisfied!
reviews.review_text: It's first time I bought Frigidaire Product. It looks nice, and More function. My wife and my family are very satisfied about this new refrigerator

reviews.title: Very nice refrigerator
reviews.review_text: Keeps true to temperature. The ice maker is a good addition. The size works well in our kitchen. My only reason for 4 stars is I wish it had a meat and cheese drawer.

reviews.title: Works well but issues
reviews.review_text: The ice maker is incredibly loud, the door compartments dont fit properly and constantly fall off. The fridge has to be a maximum setting yo ensure s normal cool for the fridge. Looks great though

reviews.title: Appreciate the size and functionality!
reviews.review_text: I've had the fridge for a couple of weeks and so far, so good! It works as it should and looks great. It's easy to see, organize and reach for everything. Very satisfied so far.

reviews.title: Sleek space saver!
reviews.review_text: I'm so happy with this fridge. It is saving significant space in my kitchen and looks great. For me, there is ample fridge space and I like the freezer organization. The ice maker is a nice bonus.

reviews.title: that's the ticket
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] was looking for something to fit specific height constraints and this fridge got the job done. just going off the specs, it would seem to have less capacity than others but that is deceiving. plenty of space for the fresh stuff. pitch the moldy stuff. not gonna eat it anyway. discipline baby. discipline.

reviews.title: So loud!

reviews.title: Cupboard depth perfect
reviews.review_text: We just installed this and it has made our kitchen beautiful. This fridge had the perfect cupboard depth we needed:: as we have a pantry door next to it and needed this size for the drawers to pull out.

reviews.title: So far so good!
reviews.review_text: Two months in. The cools were oughta and freezes where it should. I really like the dim to bright light when you open the door. Classy. I don't know. It's a fridge. It works.

reviews.title: Great fridge
reviews.review_text: I have had this fridge for a couple of weeks. It is surprisingly roomy and holds everything I need it to. Very quiet which is an improvement from my last fridge.

reviews.title: Cute and Cold
reviews.review_text: All in all, a very nice looking fridge that keeps my cold food cold and my frozen food frozen. It's a little small, but for my purposes as a single person, it will probably do just fine.

reviews.title: Great features!
reviews.review_text: It has lots of space, a great ice maker and a good size freezer. I especially love that the stainless steel finish hardly shows any fingerprints and it's super easy to clean!

reviews.title: Compact but holds a lot!
reviews.review_text: I bought this 4 months ago and am very happy with it. The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because I miss having a small cheese/deli meats drawer and a butter holder. Other than that I love it!

reviews.title: Great Fridge so far
reviews.review_text: Only about a month of use so far and it works great. One small thing that could be better though. The left side door seal thing doesnt retract enough sometimes and it hits the right side door. Not sure if theres any adjustment necessary

reviews.title: Works well
reviews.review_text: Our Frigidaire is working as it should. I like the bright light inside and the ease of grabbing stuff since I don't have to bend low to find things. Very happy with it so far.

reviews.title: Great fridge!
reviews.review_text: We have had this fridge since July. It has been great. I love how much space it has. The only thing I don't love is the middle bracket sometimes gets stuck so you have to make sure to close the one side before the other.

reviews.title: Best small fridge
reviews.review_text: Bought this fridge to fit a very small kitchen and the organization and layout in fridge and freezer is amazing. Way more flexibility and actual space inside than my previous fridge.

reviews.title: Great purchase exceeded expectation
reviews.review_text: This fridge has exceeded our expectations and does exactly what it s designed to do. The shelves are deep and it's bright. The only thing I wished it has was a light in the freezer compartment other than that it's great.

reviews.title: Nice Size
reviews.review_text: Bought this refrigerator 5-months ago and enjoy the layout and size. Not too big but with the features we need especially ice maker. Fits nicely as counter depth with built in cabinets. So far so good!

reviews.title: Sleek lines
reviews.review_text: Our new fridge fit perfectly into the small space galley kitchen. An added bonus is the counter depth, I doesn't seem like much, but it prides for a little more space. The sleek lines are a nice touch which also help keep in clean.

reviews.title: Decent fridge
reviews.review_text: The distribution doesn't seem ideal compared to our old fridge of the same size. It's more difficult to organize our food. However, it's a decent fridge for the price.

reviews.title: Excellent storage for size.
reviews.review_text: We bought this fridge a month ago, so far I am really impressed with the amount of storage it has for its size. I also really like the layout of the freezer.

reviews.title: Great refrigerator for the money
reviews.review_text: So happy with our Frigidaire purchase last month. Having the refrigerator up high and freezer below is a bonus and getting used to the French doors. So much more space and easy to find things. I recommend this Frigidaire.

reviews.title: Perfect size for our kitchen..
reviews.review_text: Choosing a new refrigerator these days is a big decision. This Frigidaire met all our requirements and was installed with no issues by our dealer. This is the first refrigerator we bought after 25 yrs. Love the new modern features.

reviews.title: Enjoy the features and size
reviews.review_text: Bought approx month ago. So far its been great. The flash freeze when putting new items into the freezer part is great. The upper fridge section is roomy, easy to see everything. We really like the fact the temperature is shown on the side.

reviews.title: Enjoying our purchase
reviews.review_text: We purchased this product a few weeks ago when our 23 year old fridge said enough!!! This is the first french door we have had and seems so much roomier than the old one and it is a first time having an ice maker which I am truley enjoying. Very happy with our purchase and will concider Frigidaire in the near future to replace the other appliances.

reviews.title: Brand new fridge took way too long!
reviews.review_text: It took weeks for the fridge to show up after I ordered it. Now it is freezing all my food and the earliest I can get a tech to even look at it is almost another 3 weeks. Once they look at it, are they going to tell me I need to wait another 3 weeks for it to be fixed? Honestly, this has been a very disappointing purchase.

reviews.title: So far so good
reviews.review_text: The fridge seems to be doing its job. Only had it for a few weeks now. A few down sides... freezer is on the small side and there is also no light in the freezer. The crisper on the right isn't able to open unless both doors are open. But on the upside. The boost freeze is handy, extra freeze mode after you go shopping. The fridge is wide open, lots of space and the led lights are so bright

reviews.title: Great Update for the Kitchen!
reviews.review_text: I just update the last of my appliances with this fridge purchase. It goes in a small space, fits well and looks great. I just hope it lasts, so I cannot speak to life span, as it did replace a 22 yr old fridge. It is certainly quiet and roomy. I am not using the ice maker so by turning that off, it made it even quieter. It arrived with shelves in the freezer, this was easy to put together. The drawers in the freezer are well made. The lightening in frdige is exceptional.

reviews.title: Great fridge so far!
reviews.review_text: Had this fridge for almost a month and so far it's been doing what it was built to do. Perfect for a small kitchen and functional in terms of compartments layout. Love the 3 different compartments in the freezer section as it allows to organize things better. No issues with noise or temperature, works perfect.

reviews.title: Great fridge so far.
reviews.review_text: Its always a gamble when you buy appliances today, but so far the fridge is awesome! The only thing is i wish they mentioned that the compressor runs all the time due to the fact its a variable speed. Also it would be a plus if the compressor wassnt as loud.

reviews.title: Really like the layout
reviews.review_text: We live in a rural area with the closest store about 100 km away - so our fridge is often really full because we cannot "just pop out to the store" if we need something! I find the layout of the fridge excellent - I can fit lots of stuff in it and everything is easily visible. The freezer is good too. Ice machine works great! Very pleased with our purchase.

reviews.title: I LOOOOVE IT!!! 100% RECOMMENDED!!!
reviews.review_text: I bought this in July 2024 after having a bad experience with a new Whirlpool refrigerator. I bought a brand new Whirlpool refrigerator in July 2024 but as soon as I plugged it in, I regretted the purchase since it was making a very loud and annoying low bass-like noise. Also the surface of the stainless steel doors of the Whirlpool refrigerator already had issues - it was already having unremovable stains. So I was super disappointed and couldn't keep it. I had to return the Whirlpool refrigerator. Then I researched and purchased a new Frigidaire fridge and OMG, this is soooo quiet, and beautiful!! Every single detail of this fridge is so well-made and this is AMAAAAZING!!! I'm super happy that I got this!!!

reviews.title: Great features!
reviews.review_text: Very happy with this fridge. It's not as deep as the bigger models so I can actually reach the back!! And having so many drawers in the freezer is a bonus for storage!! I'm in my 70s and a widow, So don't require the capacity of the larger fridges.

reviews.title: Simple!
reviews.review_text: I wanted a counter depth fridge and I'm Very happy I stuck to my guns. It fits way better than my old non counter depth fridge. I chose this model because I hate too many frills on a fridge. I want it to be easy and quick to clean so it can stay clean. This simple interior design is perfect, 3 large shelves that go from side to side. The only downside that isnt really a downside in there are only 2 crispers. So I added my own clear plastic basket to just help organize things. The doors hold quite a bit more than what they look like they hold. Exterior is quick to clean with soap and water and finger prints come right off. Not bad for too many fingers prints either. The freezer is compartmentalized which I love. I have a bigger freezer so now I can keep everything organized that I use more frequently in this freezer and no exactly where to look for an item. This fridge says in the specs that it is smaller than my last fridge but because of the way it's laid out it is actually bigger, I have way more room. I am extremely satisfied with this fridge and would 100% buy it again!

reviews.title: Great fridge with great freezer organization.
reviews.review_text: We bought this fridge roughly a month ago and so far we are very happy with it. We love the drawers in the freezer as they provide additional organization. In comparison to a 33 or 36 inch fridge this fridge seems very small but it stores a lot! We thought at first we may regret not getting a bigger fridge but we always have free space available.

reviews.title: Well organized food compartments. Spacious.
reviews.review_text: I bought this fridge a couple weeks ago to replace my old side-by-side fridge. Can't believe how much space there is both in the fridge and freezer sections. I love my new Frigidaire fridge. Great design. Now I'm inspired to repaint my kitchen!

reviews.title: Great fridge for a busy household!
reviews.review_text: We purchased this fridge a month ago and we are very happy with it! It's spacious, and fits more than our old fridge about the same size. Placement of the shelves and compartments makes sense. We have two teenaged boys who are very active with sports, so it gets used A LOT! I like that the doors close automatically, and the lights turn off if it's open for too long. Set up was super easy! In the end, we opted to not hook up the ice maker, as we did find it a bit loud when it was first turned on (no different than all other fridges with ice makers). I like that we have the option to turn it on/off. Really happy with this purchase!!

reviews.title: Good use of space for a compact size
reviews.review_text: Got this to replace another Frigidaire that is going elsewhere in the house. Love the French door design compared to a single door. The decreased depth makes my tiny kitchen feel a lot more spacious. A little bit noisier than my old one but nothing overwhelming.

reviews.title: Great refrigerator
reviews.review_text: Our original fridge was an LP. Worked pretty good for 10 years, although made a lot of funny noises. Decided to give up during a heat wave. Called a couple of places and no one apparently works on LP's. anyway decided to go with a frididaire as they are a name that's been around forever and the ratings were good. So far so good, it's working great and no funny noises. Lol

reviews.title: Great fridge
reviews.review_text: We love this refrigerator, especially with the many shelves on the doors and the ample crisper space for vegetables and fruits. The ice maker is an added bonus along with the three drawers of freezer space. The only issue we have had with the drawer containing the ice maker keeps slipping off the track. This can be quite annoying and really shouldn't be happening with a refrigerator that is only three months old.

reviews.title: Love this new fridge!
reviews.review_text: It's been about a month since we bought our new fridge. I love the depth of it and the features it has. The depth allows you to see everything inside easily so things don't get lost at the back. The side shelves are perfect in size. I also love that unlike stainless steel, it doesn't have finger prints!!

reviews.title: Almost Perfect!
reviews.review_text: I've owned the fridge for a few weeks now and I love it. It was hard to find a fridge that fit the space but this one does perfectly. It looks good, the temperature is stable (nothing freezes in the fridge portion), and it's quiet. My only issue is the French doors - the left door has a folding flap that sometimes hits the other door. I don't know if I'm accidentally moving it to cause this, but a few times I've hit the other door and had to adjust the flap to get the door closed. The other issue is that the doors need to be pushed closed - you can't let them glide closed on their own. Overall I'm happy with my purchase, I just wish the doors were engineered a bit better.

reviews.title: A good fridge for 2-3 people
reviews.review_text: So far so good, this fridge has a nice layout to it the only downside is when you open the right door only you can't pull out the right crisper drawer because the seal between the doors gets in the way, but if you open the left door only you can open the left crisper drawer. Just a design feature not fully thought out. We do love how bright the lighting is inside when we are trying to find something and it definitely keeps our food fresher longer compared to our other fridge.

reviews.title: Looks sharp and fits!
reviews.review_text: So far loving this fridge. My old one was a side by side that was too long for the space. I searched high and low for a fridge to fit cupboards that are 69 inches from the floor and counter depth. This was the one. It has lots of space and we love the ice maker.

reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.review_text: We bought this refrigerator about a month ago and so far it is doing well. We had limited space and it fit perfectly. We were also looking for the bottom freezer which is a big plus. We lost a bit of refrigerator space but having the bottom freezer reduced many trips downstairs to the chest freezer

reviews.title: Love everything about this fridge
reviews.review_text: Design is simple but elegant (perfect for our great room which is also part of living & dining area). Lots of space & easy to keep clean inside and out. Controls simple to operate & easy to see items in freezer and fridge sections. Icemaker is perfect & can be turned off when there is enough ice. Operates very quietly. Overall I am more than happy with this fridge.

reviews.title: Frigidaire fridge
reviews.review_text: My new fridge is very nice except the doors doesn't auto close. A bit frustrating! However, I like that it's spacious and quiet. I didn't like the air filter is situated at the very back top wall of the fridge. It will not be easy to replace the filter.i like the drawers and the bins. So far, it's working well for my family.

reviews.title: Great compact fridge for smaller spaces
reviews.review_text: I recently purchased this refrigerator and am impressed with its efficiency and compact size. It consumes minimal energy while fitting seamlessly into my kitchen. Its stylish design adds a modern touch, and the spacious fridge area accommodates all my groceries without feeling cluttered.

reviews.title: Great storage!
reviews.review_text: I purchased and received this fridge a few weeks ago and couldn't be happier! It is very sleek both inside and out and has great storage capacity both in the fridge and freezer. Digital temperature control is easy to use and filter is easy to access. Great fridge, higher recommend!

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.review_text: Was really impressed with the look of frigid, and the layout inside was perfect.

reviews.title: Great features!

reviews.review_text: I bought this a month ago and could not be happier. Super quiet and efficient. Very stylish and fairly easy to clean

reviews.title: Haikus are easy, but sometimes they don't make sense, refrigerator...
reviews.review_text: Great fridge. Well lit. Purchased the fridge a month ago. So far so good. Last one was a 2011 model making loud noises. Same manufacturer. This one makes quieter noises, and seems to have better regulation/control over the compressor. Nice clean lines, easy install. Good handles. Magnetic surface despite stainless steel finish is a bonus. The finish does scratch with certain magnets fairly easily so those have been moved to the side of the fridge. Not sure how that can be avoided with a metal surface though. It is arranged well, though door shelves were a little tight to install, I am worried the plastic might break if I attempt to take them out and move around. So try to think about where to put them as you set up the door shelves. Doors all seem to have a good seal. The left door is the one with the... vertical flapper bar? that the right door rests on to make a seal in the middle, between the two doors. This flapper thing sometimes pops out a little far when you only open the left door and try to close it, hitting the right door. I sometimes have to poke the flapper to let the door close, not really a big deal but can be annoying. I hope that over time the flap will get worn-in and stop popping out as much. It does seem to be happening less over time. We'll see. The freezer drawer/door has a good seal. It makes kind of a loud pop whenever I open it. As the seal releases. Not sure how normal that is. Almost seems to be magnetically assisted when closing. But no issues so far. Hopefully good for another 250,000 pulls! The energy rating was an important factor in fridge selection. This one was a little better than most of the similar size. I have to admit, beyond spending a lot more for an ultra efficient fridge, they all seemed pretty similar in the price range. I liked that this unit actually had its energy rating easily visible on all the sites it was listed on. I like it. I would recommend.

reviews.title: Perfect size
reviews.review_text: We bought this fridge a few weeks ago and love it. With just the 2 of us it's the perfect size. Lots of room in the freezer with the 2 drawers plus basket, it's quiet and fits well in our small space. The only negative thing is the wires and hoses show at the back/side if you have an open side where your fridge sits.

reviews.title: Smaller refrigerator, good look
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This is a smaller refrigerator for older cabinet openings. The ice maker is inside the freezer. Only one type of cube that doesn't fit in some of my drink cups (swell). You need to open both doors to properly access the crispers. Ice will drop even though the door is open and the tray is pulled out. The capacity of the refrigerator is good even with the smaller size. The top door bins are easily adjustable, however I am unable to adjust the lower bins even though it looks like it's possible. Cannot find any info on this. I still like this refrigerator even with these quirks.

reviews.title: Small, French door refrigerator FRFG1723AV
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The FRFG1723AV refrigerator is a perfect fit for my small space, which required a <68” height. This was the only option I found in a stainless, French door style. The interior design maximizes storage space in both the refrigerator and freezer area. The price point was very reasonable, too. I'd highly recommend this model.

reviews.title: Great use of space
reviews.review_text: I bought this refrigerator a month ago to replace a 30" Whirlpool refrigerator which was brand new as well but didn't work well from day 1. The problem I had with the Whirlpool was that the temperature uniformity from one shelf to another varied greatly where the top shelf would be 44°F (which is not food safe, and the crisper drawers would be 30°F which would freeze my veggies. So I retired the Whirlpool and went with the Frigidaire and I'm so glad I did. The temperature uniformity with this fridge is excellent. The temperature is the same on every shelf and in the crisper drawers. The simple layout in the interior of this fridge is far better than the Whirlpool I returned and, even though the Frigidaire is smaller by 1.5 cuft there is actually more useable space in this fridge. This ice maker makes ice quickly, the interior light in the fridge is a nice cool color, and the outside of the fridge is sleek. Not to mention the door baskets are well constructed, sturdy, and have good storage space. The freezer is a good space and the addition of drawers inside the freezer is a nice addition which I wasn't sure if I would like but I love them. They are great for keeping meat, fish, etc from frozen fruit or bread and the ice being enclosed in a drawer is nice as well so it doesn't impart flavors from other foods in the freezer. The only thing I'd like to see from this fridge would be an internal water dispenser and a light in the freezer but these are minor issues. All in all I highly recommend this refrigerator. Especially if you are in need of a 30" refrigerator.

reviews.title: I don't hate
reviews.review_text: With all new models being the french door type (which I am not a fan of) it restricts the options when replacing an older, larger, single swing door fridge so this model was literally all we had to choose from. With that said, overall it is fine and works as a fridge should. There is a lot of space in the freezer. In the fridge part, the produce & fruit drawers are small and fit very little which means I have to keep a fair amount of my veg on the shelves, which I don't love. Could use a third drawer for cheese & deli. It is not the most efficient use of space.

reviews.title: Best Refrigerator Bang For the Buck..
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Love this gorgeous refrigerator/freezer! It's everything I wanted - spacious with lots of compartments to keep everything organized! It is just the right size for me, and I especially love the bottom freezer with 3 compartments and an ice maker! Finally, the French door design is exactly what I was looking for! Simply perfect!

reviews.title: Space is everything
reviews.review_text: Our old fridge died recently so we made a quick decision to buy this model based on its dimensions to fit into our narrow kitchen. This fridge is small (in a good way), easy to maneuver, and surprisingly lightweight. The top refrigerator unit is deep and wide with shelves to move around and deep door shelves to maximize. It's almost too much space which is not a bad thing! Temperature control is digital and easy to use for both the fridge and freezer underneath. Speaking of the freezer, it's bigger than you think it is at first glance. The main drawer fits everything perfectly where, in our old vertical freezer, took up so much space. But that's not all, the second drawer pulls out above the main drawer and has even more space and contains the easy-to-access ice maker with a scoop! The things that make me happy in my thirties... Anyway, there's also a third drawer that pulls out and I can't be more thankful for this design. You can pull out each drawer on its own and close them all together when you're finished. The whole unit runs fairly quietly. My only complaint is closing the left side door. There's a flap that locks into place when you close the left side first then the right. However, if you close the right first and then the left, the flap often stops you from closing the door without manually flattening it and closing it again. Startles me every time I don't close the fridge "properly." I'll get used to it. Overall, I'm so thankful for this unit.

reviews.title: Small Freezer, Quality Refrigerator
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Nice refrigerator space for a smaller refrigerator. Small freezer space means an additional freezer will be needed. Not enough room for 2 people to have a variety of dinners, lunches, ice cream etc. Good for a single person who buys almost all fresh food only.

reviews.title: Great Fridge for a Reasonable Price

reviews.title: Great features

reviews.title: Great Chill
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I bought this fridge 3 weeks ago & it exceeds my hopes. It's QUIET. The motor runs infrequently, probably because it's so well insulated. Moveable shelves allowed for fitting the fridge to my needs. Just wonderful!

reviews.title: Holds temperature perfectly.
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Two thermometers in the freezer and refrigerator each. The door and back are the same and perfectly in range for each. The receded door handles are a pinch hazard, if you try to close the door with fingers outside the receded region. And it seems to run compressor more on than off. Wondering how much electricity is going to cost. Not ruining food is more important.

reviews.title: Replacing a 20+ year-old refrigerator
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I really like it. It looks so beautiful in my kitchen. I like how the shelves in the door accommodate the big fat bottles of Smartwater and the smaller half size shelves are great as they can hold anything from a bag of shredded cheese to a tall bottle of Worcestershire sauce with ease. I never used the crisper drawers in my former refrigerator and had even removed them to create another shelf. The crisper drawers that I am now using and love Work so well and keeping Produce fresh and for long periods of time.

reviews.title: Limited in space, I bought this 28" Whirlpool.
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Actually, I would give this refrigerator 4 1/2 stars. I have room for a 30" frig but after endless searching (others' reviews and Consumer Reports) I chose this Whirlpool because my primary goal was to find a refrigerator that kept temperature. So far so good! Setting the temperature for the freezer and the refrigerator takes a bit of patience but for me the factory setting was a bit too cold and I dialed it down a notch. I also was cautious when I read about some models being noisy. I definitely didn't want that. As it is, this one isn't silent - the motor sound isn't loud but it does run at a rather high pitched tone (think a Tesla starting up). I love the deli drawer but miss having a butter keeper. All in all, given the options for my narrow space, I think I made the right choice.

reviews.title: Well Designed and Well Built
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This New Refrigerator is slightly smaller than our original one. It Holds More groceries than our Larger model! The Storage and Compartments are Fantastic. It is Very Well Designed and Gorgeous exterior. It keeps all our items Cold and Freezer is Perfect! Job well done by Whirlpool.

reviews.title: Lots of room for a small refrigerator
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] It's good. There's enough room in the refrigerator section - especially for such a small unit. But the freezer has no light in it. And I think that's ridiculous. I often come down at night to grab something from the freeze. And now I have to turn the light on in the room to see what's in the freezer. How much would it have cost them to put a bulb in the freezer?? Also there is no ice maker. That is annoying but does give me more room in the tiny freezer.

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I am happy with this refrigerator, but if I had it to do over again I'd never buy the silver door. It's impossible to get fingerprints off. It also runs pretty cold. I like the placement options for the shelves. It's much smaller than my last one, and the advantage is that it moves easily and I can clean under and behind it with no problems.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] So I've had my refrigerator since July 12th. I sent the first one back because of what I felt was a manufacture defect. The top was unleveled and the seal around the door was slightly damaged. I bought it brand new. Since receiving the second one I am much happier. The shelves feel awkwardly placed but I'm getting used to it. I love all the shelves in the door. I wish there was a light in the freezer. The last door shelf is kinda placed weirdly but I realize they were trying to make use of all space. I'm glad only the front is stainless steel. The sides are just a grey finish. Which match the grills on my white stove

reviews.title: Okay
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Okay for price paid. Finish work/glue a little sloppy. Also I was very very disappointed when it arrived with the R609a refrigerant. The model in stores have the older refrigerant which is why I bought it. I am know worried this one will not have a long life. My repair man says the refrigerant makes a difference. Fortunately I purchased the extended warranty this time.

reviews.title: Great replacement!
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Our old refrigerator was over 20 years old so we needed to replace it and wanted something in stainless steel. We live in a row home and needed a smallish model. We are very happy with this model. Even though it isn't as wide as our old refrigerator there is still plenty of space for all our food, drinks, condiments and frozen items. We're very happy with our purchase.

reviews.title: Good deal
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I've had my refrigerator now for a little over a month and I really like it. reviews.title: Does what it says
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I received this refrigerator/freezer and icemaker as a replacement for one I purchased in 2021. The refrigerator looks just like the picture. No mars on the stainless finish. The men who put it in were very nice and cleaned up and took the old frig away.

reviews.title: Quality ?
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I bought this 08/27/25 and received it on 09/03. It goes well with the other appliances in appearance and functionality. The grey sides and top are a nice relief from black and helps to lighten the kitchen a bit more. I would have given 5 stars if the top of freezer door and bottom of the fridge door had a finishing plug for the holes in the trim. That must be where the foam is injected into the doors. It looks and feels unfinished. Good insulating job because the foam shows at the seams where the black plastic trim meets the stainless steel. It looks good, sounds good, and has nice LED lighting.

reviews.title: Basically happy
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I did not purchase the model with the EZ connect icemaker. The refrigerator is spacious but should have another shelf. As for the freezer, it is disprortionately small.. It ran continuously for 24 hours but it finally stopped.

reviews.title: OK refrig but not recommended for a household
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] BE AWARE: Bought this rerig for our garage. Delivery and set up, take away of old refrig all went well. After waiting 24 hours to store food in refrig and freezer noticed freezer was coated with frozen ice droplets, wiped them up and next day same issue. Repair came and heated the seal on freezer. Better but still had frost/droplets across top of freezer. Second repairman came, called engineering who told him that the air flow is such in this refrig that when you open the refrig door, air pushes into the freezer and causes a small air gap in the freezer seal that cannot be fixed!! Suggested that everytime we open refrig to push freezer shut to avoid this issue. If you want to do this, ok. If not, offered to give me the cost of this refrig on purchase of another. As ours is not our main refrig and in the garage we opted to keep this refrig.

reviews.title: Nice small refrigerator!!!!
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Owned it a couple weeks now, and overall am happy with my new fridge. Controls very easy to use, and maintains temperatures in the freezer section and fresh food section very well. Looks nice, too, very compact, sleek, easy to use. As a single man, it's all I need !! The door swing had to be changed from left to right, which I did myself, took about 30 minutes, easy to do. Complaints would be absence of a light in the freezer section, pretty dark in there!! And sometimes while running, the fridge emits a very low toned 'siren' sound while the compressor is running, but not all the time. Overall, for the price, it's a good buy.

reviews.title: Exterior is easy to clean.
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] We remodeled our kitchen and wanted stainless steel to match our stove. The Whirlpool fridge fit the bill and was priced right. It stays cold on auto setting. Keeps milk and other beverages very cold and that's the way we like it.

reviews.title: Great for small Kitchens
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Having a small kitchen made our choices for fridges limited.. this was a great choice. Inches feel like feet in a small kitchen and having a few inches back really helps. So far great fridge for the price.

reviews.title: Convinient storage
reviews.review_text: (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) I bought this fridge in May 2018, the inside is very convinient storage, the water and ice system doesn't take too much room in the fridge. My only complaint is the finger print on the front surface. I highly recommend you get the protection, I didn't and I regret it.

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I purchased my 28 inch Whirlpool refrigerator on April 29. It is so vety quiet that I hardly ever hear it. I love the fact that the handles are built in, so the entire front is flat. It is black and matches my stove and also my notty pine kitchen. I am extremely happy with my new refrigerater!!

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Once I moved the shelves to where they worked best for my needs, I have liked it. Changed from a larger side by side with an ice maker to a smaller refrigerator with no ice maker. Having to adjust to a smaller freezer.

reviews.title: Good size for 2nd refrigerator

I bought the same kind again because I liked the design and size for that space.

reviews.title: Extra large freezer fit into same small space.
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Older frig stopped at inopportune time for December. Temps oddly at 70 degrees for few days then dropped to freezing. Lost all of my food and freezer contents. Now happier tho with the new Whirlpool upgrade and love the larger freezer on top. Unexpected delight with decision. Thanks.

reviews.title: Just what we needed!
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] We needed to replace a refrigerator that was 36 years old, still running, but figured it was time for a new one. The price was incredible, the look of it is slick, (I hadn't planned on buying a silver one, but I now love it!) Its a little smaller than the one we had previously, but since its just the 2 of us, its great and oh so quiet! So far so good!

reviews.title: Beautiful but requires constant care

reviews.title: Great fridge!
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I've had this refrigerator for a couple of months and am very happy with my purchase. I purchased the icemaker separately. Everything worked out great!

reviews.title: Great looking small refrigerator!
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This is a nice Fridge. Comming from a dual French Door KitchenAid (wonderful until it dies after 10 years), this is very small compared to that BUT it is quiet and quite functional. We especially like the horizontal sliding drawer in the fridge section. Also purchased the optional OEM ice maker. It takes up 12 inches in the freezer section. Overall, I like to call this a "modern, old school refrigerator". We expect this to last a very long time. If you like bells and whistles though....this ain't it.

reviews.title: Great refrigerator for the price!

reviews.title: Great but ..

reviews.title: Door not fully set up to reverse
reviews.review_text: The door is not exactly reversible. I don't know, I think your guy that does that part of the build went home early that day. We didn't notice and only moved one, to which the little cover fit but the cover didn't fit the bolt we didn't move (see photo). If you had have built the fridge properly, we could have changed door orientation in about a 1/2 hour, but because you did not build the fridge properly, it took almost two hours to change door orientation, and weren't sure what we were doing. And yes, my guy is experienced in this, and also yes, we tried to follow your inadequate instructions.

reviews.title: Excellent room

I would like for there to have been more variability in the temperature control but I understand that this one is a more basic model.

reviews.title: Nice finish & fairly quiet
reviews.review_text: (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) reviews.title: Door problems

reviews.title: Great features

reviews.title: Perfect Size and Great Performance!

reviews.title: An Excellent Upgrade

reviews.title: Great for our smaller need

reviews.title: Great features!

reviews.title: Not so great

reviews.title: Good value for the price

reviews.title: Mediocre

reviews.title: Happy with my purchase

reviews.title: Nice compact fridge

reviews.title: It keeps the temperatures very well.

reviews.title: Great refrigerator

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This is my first Whirlpool purchase. It meets my needs, but it seems to be running more than my previous refrigerator. reviews.title: Trust the negative reviews
reviews.review_text: Review all the negative reviews if you are thinking about buying this junk. The positive reviews likely are just Fluff for sales. The quality is very very low. The US factory this was manufactured/assembled in makes it impossible to remove the protective plastic. Its put on prior to assembly so the plastic is imbedded in all the connecting parts. Also has the internal insulating foam coming out of every crack and space it can on the outside sides, back, and doors. If you are thinking of buying this junk, just make sure you check all the negative reviews and know they are true, Like I said its very likely all the positive reviews are Whirlpool's fluff, the negative reviews will give you a better picture of the fridge to make a decision.

reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Very nice stainless fridge for a small space. The interior is uncluttered to begin with and most of the storage bins can be removed, freeing large spaces inside. reviews.title: Keeps my food fresher, longer. Great door storage!
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] It seems like it keeps my food fresher, longer. I also like that it doesn't come with an ice maker, but that the ice maker can be added later. Because it is deeper than my last refrigerator, it holds more food too. What I like best about it is all the storage space in the door. My last fridge had a butter shelf, that took up half the width of the top. Then, it only had 1 other 'shelf' beneath that. This has 3 full 'shelves' in the door, and I like how the top 2 shelves are divided in 2 - length wise. It's very helpful. A few small quibbles. The freezer top shelf doesn't go all the way to the back, so small items can fall to the lower level. Also, when removing the wrap from the front door - the only part of the fridge with stainless steel - it's almost impossible to get it all out of the area on the top of the fridge that it attached to. It scratches fairly easily, too, so it would be nice if a stainless steel wipes packet would be included with the fridge. But, I'm overall very happy. I don't know that I'd get a stainless steel again, but I would definitely buy this model again, maybe in black so it doesn't show dirt. White fridges show dirt. Stainless steel fridges scratch. I think my next fridge, which hopefully won't be for 13 more years, will be black.

reviews.title: Works in a Small Space in 100 Year Vintage Home
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I recently purchased this small refrigerator, for my almost 100-year-old house! Finding an appliance that fits compact space leaves me with very few options. This fridge, however, almost slid in perfectly but I did have to remove the solid oak vintage trim to get it in there. A plus for me was the reversible door feature. Being able to choose whether it opens to the left or right made all the difference in making it work. Honestly, I don't need my fridge to communicate with me or send text. My only real complaint, and it's a bit of an ongoing one, is that the freezer door tends to pop open whenever I close the main fridge door. I do have to remember to give the freezer a quick check each time to make sure it's sealed properly, so I don't end up with an unexpected thaw. The other thing I miss is a meat drawer. Overall, if you're in a similar situation with limited space or an older home, this fridge is definitely worth considering. Just be mindful of that freezer door!

reviews.title: A Surprisingly GREAT Basic Refrigerator
reviews.review_text: I needed a fairly compact fridge for a small cabin and the quality of this was so much better than the too-small apartment size units that I decided to pay a little more money to get a lot more refrigerator. I liked the glass shelves and separate controls for fridge and freezer. It arrived factory-set to almost perfect temperatures, cooled quickly and stays very consistent. I don't hear it running and the lighting inside is quite bright. Three weeks later, a storm left us without power for 42 hours. Food was still cold after 24 hours! I moved frozen food to a freezer powered by a generator and used an ice chest for things like milk and mayo. After the power was restored, I was stunned to find the few items left in the fridge were still fairly cold and there were still ice cubes (although wet) in their trays in the freezer! I'm very happy with this purchase.The only thing that would make it better is if there was a drawer for storing meat/cheese, even if it was optional.

reviews.review_text: We purchased this through the app at our local Wal-Mart. We wanted a small chest freezer for frozen foods storage, and this one is perfect. It's actually the second one that I have putchased, but my original one was left behind on the west coast when I moved. I had been so impressed with that one that I purchased another. I did notice that some of the reviews mentioned receiving a damaged item. My advice is to purchase it at your local store if possible. Sometimes delivery services such as UPS or FedEx aren't exactly gentle with their deliveries. A Wal-Mart employee was able to fit it in the back of my Chevy Blazer without any problem.

Perfect size for a small one bedroom apartment. Very very quiet, you don't even know it's running. I really like the light indicator on the outside to assure me it's on and the basket it comes with. Best investment I've ever made! I have saved so much money buying larger bulk items vs. weekly groceries knowing the food keeps longer than your traditional refrigerator freezer.

reviews.title: I love my FREEZER Five Stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.review_text: Five Stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I absolutely LOVE my deep freezer! As a small business owner running a home bakery, this is goaded for me. I definitely needed the extra freezer space, and it did not disappoint. I’ve seen so many bad reviews about dents and damages, so I was nervous. But let me tell you—mine arrived in perfect condition. No dents, no scratches, nothing. It even came super fast! I ordered mine at 2 a.m., and it was delivered by 10 a.m. the same day. I wasn’t even expecting it until later that night, so that was a pleasant surprise. If you’re debating whether to buy this—buy it! Run and get it. It gets cold fast. I turned mine on, and within 30 minutes, it was already really cold. It has different settings (minimum, mid, and max), and of course, I set mine to max because I need my treats frozen solid. The size is perfect. It’s actually bigger than I expected—about 4 feet wide and 3.5 feet tall—so there’s plenty of space. It also comes with a small tray at the top, which is perfect for organizing. I added small bins inside to keep my treats separate from my regular food, which helps keep everything organized and clean. The price? $165. I hesitate to spend over $100 on anything, but this was worth it. You also get a one-year warranty, so make sure to fill out that paperwork! And let’s be real—who wants to haul a freezer home from the store when Walmart delivers it for free once you spend over $35? I know how hard it is to find honest reviews because some people just love to bash companies, making it impossible to tell if something is actually good or not. But this is my honest experience, and I hope this helps someone who’s been debating like I was. I’ll update this review in a week, but so far—five stars all the way!

reviews.title: Nice Machine
reviews.review_text: Very quiet, freezes fast, nice and large inside but still compact on the outside. Had minimal damage but still had couple of dents. reviews.title: Great freezer, but BAD CHEMICAL OFF-GASSING
reviews.review_text: The freezer works fine once set up, but I need to warn people: when I first opened it in my garage (before even plugging it in), I was blasted with the worst chemical offgassing I've ever experienced. Didn't expect a literal wall of VOCs to hit me in the face. One deep breath and immediately I had issues breathing. It persisted days after. I'm a young adult, healthy, and don't have asthma or any breathing problems, so for it to have affected me that long shows just how strong the offgassing was. There was no warning label about ventilation. Without airing it out first, all those toxic chemicals just get sealed in with your food. I wouldn't risk that, especially with long-term storage. This is preventable so it's just manufacturing laziness from companies to not air out ahead of time. If you're sensitive to breathing in harmful chemicals, have asthma, or even enjoy breathing, DO NOT open this in a closed room. I recommend letting it sit outside for a full day, wiping everything down, and leaving baking soda trays inside before plugging it in The design's solid for the price, but zero points for user safety or transparency. Would be 5 stars if they included an offgassing warning at the very least, but really customers should not have to worry about this.

reviews.title: Buyer Beware
reviews.review_text: My freezer was delivered in an SUV and left in my driveway upside down. No one rang my doorbell. They just dropped it off and left. I would of called them to come pick it back up if there was any damage to the box, but the box had no imperfections at all so I figured I had received an undamaged product. NOT SO. My husband was out of town for a couple of weeks so I was unable to open it for awhile and took another week so he could run a direct electric line to it. Once opened, it had a large dent that went from the front to the side. How could this happen with a perfectly unmarred box? Is the company taking their returns and reboxing them?? I looked all over for a phone number to call Walmart to lodge my complaint, but all you can talk to is a computer and there is no area to talk about damages. Will this dent void the extra warranty I paid for from Walmart? I went ahead and plugged it in and have monitored the temperature for 2 weeks now and it seems to be running fine even with the dent. I don't really care about the dent as the freezer is in a place that only the family can see, but I do believe I am due a discount due to the damage. Should I have to pay full price for a damaged freezer? I like the freezer. It is the perfect size for us so I gave only 3 stars due to the way it was delivered by Walmart and because of the manufacturer's attempt at trying to hide the damage by reboxing.

reviews.title: Perfect size and works great
reviews.review_text: This may sound silly, but trying to find a mini fridge without bold company logos on the front is difficult because some are really tacky and that bothers me. I wanted a small black fridge with a gold handle. I bought this one, and purchased a gold handle with an adhesive backing that arrives tomorrow. This should have a “clean but custom” look. The dimensions are perfect for one person. I cut out a shelf in my loft to set this at the right height. The bottom part back is intended to be open. I see complaints from these small fridges that they are missing the “back.” The back is intended to face the wall and gives the compressor breathing room. Hard to tell from the photos but there is 19 inches behind the fridge. The item arrived with zero dents and cooled down completely the same night. I don't hear it at all, so I would say it's very quiet. The space is perfect for late-night snacks and any “go-to” items without having to go downstairs. The only thing that could be better is the energy efficiency. This is rated a (2) so it will cost more to run annually than a higher rating. All in all, I love the fridge, and it was a good purchase

reviews.title: Unbalanced/tips over a little when door opens
reviews.review_text: I just plugged it in today and so far it is working fine and getting cold. The mini freezer compartment seems to get very cold as well (my little thermometer in the picture I brought in from outside to test it says about 20° F). Started getting cold almost immediately after plugging it in. So so far I'm satisfied with how cold it's getting which is why I bought it because I had just bought a smaller “personal chiller” from a different brand that did not get cold enough so I had to take that one back. The only issue I'm having with it which was present before plugging in is that it is unbalanced so it tips over a little whenever I open it. It seems that one of the 4 feet/legs on the bottom 4 corners of the fridge must be slightly shorter than the others. It is annoying but so far not causing too much issue. It's also not too loud in my opinion. It does make noise but it is not constant. It gets a little louder after it's been open for a minute and probably the compressor/machine or something needs to work to keep it cool (idk how fridges work lol) so that is the loudest part but again, that specific noise is not constant. I think it does make some noise though. If the Walmart website lets me I will update if anything changes but so far so good after only a day.

The door is reversible, it's light enough for one adult to move around, and setup was as easy as removing the stickers and plugging it in. I let it run empty for just a few hours then it was good to stock with food and drinks. Its not terribly loud at all, and doesn't run for a long amount of time. This model has a freezer compartment but honestly I haven't tried it out yet. But please note, the user manual says for "temporary" storage of frozen items, so I assume they will not stay frozen for a long time. All in all, this is a fantastic mini fridge, and I'm extremely pleased with my purchase.
